reviewer_notes: 与 90160（观看表演、比赛等的人）为同一义项，且本 sense 的释义含错误限定。应退役本 sense，保留 90160。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “坐着看表演或比赛的人”错误地限定了坐姿。观众也可以站着，句 1（站起来鼓掌）与句 9（都站了起来）与该释义冲突。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹“坐着看表演或比赛的人”带有同样的坐姿限定。

definition: 表示次数居第二。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so the other defects do not need patches. For the record: variant A level_3 distractors 鸡蛋, 地铁 and 假期 are non-temporal and therefore trivially wrong, and variant B level_7's 把 explanation is loose.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90267. 表示次数居第二 and 做过一遍后再做的这一回 describe the same usage. Every sentence here fits 90267's definition (for example 这是学校第二次开运动会 is the second occurrence of the event). Two senses a learner cannot separate fail sense pinning.

definition: 煮熟的谷类食物，特指米饭；也泛指每天定时吃的食物。
reviewer_notes: If this sense is kept after a split, also fix: B level_6 wrong sentences are all measure-word errors (一只/一张/一根), the same defect as 90285. A level_3 and level_7 are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 90285 (cooked rice plus regular meal). The two senses cover the same sentence types, so a learner cannot pin one sense against the other.

definition: 高年是年纪很大的时候。
reviewer_notes: reject 仅因核心重复，且定义不合格。保留的义项为 90292。未生成补丁。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 90292 为同一义项：两者都释为「年纪大的时期」，指纹仅措辞不同。定义「高年是年纪很大的时候。」是以词条自身开头的复述句，也不合格。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「这一个高年」并非确实错误：「个」是通用量词，「一个时期」「一个阶段」很常见，该「错误句」会被判为可接受。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 解释「不能与「和」连用」在语法上不成立。抽象名词可与「和」并列，真正原因是语义不符（高年不指具体的人）。

definition: 主人是家里欢迎客人的人。小狗的主人是养它的人。
reviewer_notes: reject 因为核心义项未拆分，补丁无法修正。B 侧的 level_3、level_6、level_7（只/位错误）大体干净，但整体仍需重做。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，却没有对应 block，且 morphological_forms 中有 女主人/男主人，需核对 plan。未生成补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义由两句分别描述两个义项：「家里欢迎客人的人」与「养它的人」。sense_fingerprint「家里招待客人的人；养小动物的人」也合并了二者，违反一义一条。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: 锚句 variants.A.level_3 用的是「接待客人」义（主人给客人倒茶），而 level_6 的正确句 sentence 3「小猫看见主人回家」用的是「所有者」义。同一义项内出现义项漂移。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「主人偷走了他的手表」在「接待客人的一方」义下可以成立（作客时主人行窃），并非确实错误。; variants.A.level_1: 以「no_minimal_pairs」放弃，但「住人」(zhù rén) 是真实词，与「主人」仅声调不同，构成可用的最小对立。放弃理由不成立。; core: 与 90304 义项重叠：两者都合并了「接待客人」与「所有者」两个义项，属于重复。

definition: 接待客人的一方；也指财物、动物等的所有者。
reviewer_notes: reject 因为核心义项未拆分。B 侧的 level_3 和 level_7（只/位错误）大体干净，但整体仍需重做。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，却没有对应 block，需核对 plan。未生成补丁。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义「接待客人的一方；也指财物、动物等的所有者」在一个词条内合并了两个义项，违反一义一条。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: level_6 的正确句 sentence 3「主人把客人送到了门口」用的是「接待客人」义，而 level_3 锚句「房子的主人把钥匙交给了我们」用的是「所有者」义。同一义项内出现义项漂移。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「主人在场边指导队员」在「所有者」义下可以成立（球队的主人在场边），并非确实错误。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 解释「搭配：『找到』与『价格』搭配不当」不准确，「找到它的价格」在语法上成立，真正的问题是语境不合。; variants.A.level_1 / variants.B.level_1: 两处都以「no_minimal_pairs」放弃，但「住人」(zhù rén) 是真实词，构成可用的最小对立。; core: 与 90303 义项重叠（两者都合并了「接待客人」与「所有者」）。

definition: 见面时互相问候的常用语。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense. Its level_6 and level_7 sentences are otherwise grammatical. Regenerate only if 90309 is removed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 90309 为同一义项（叹词，见面问候），属重复义项。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “喂，请问这里有人吗？”本身地道，“喂”可作正确答案，属可辩护的正确干扰项；解释以语域为由也站不住。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: “学中文，第一个要学的词就是……”未限定时间，“晚上好”同为问候语，不能算明显错误。

definition: 像黄金一样的颜色。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 90313. If 90314 is kept instead, the B-level_3 explanations must be rewritten as described above. Its sentences, A-level blocks and B-level_6/7 blocks are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 90313, the same colour sense of 金色 with overlapping fingerprints. Keeping both teaches one sense twice.; variants.B.level_3.options[0].explanation: Explanations are copied from another document. They refer to "这本书的封面是金色的", but the cloze sentence for this block is sentence 6, "他买了一条金色的鱼。"; variants.B.level_3.options[1..3].explanation: The distractor explanations (夜晚, 雨, 歌声) all refer to 封面 and "是……的", not to the fish sentence. "夜晚的鱼" is also weakly defensible without the time-versus-colour point.

definition: 购买和出售；生意。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense should not exist separately. For the record, if the curator keeps it: A level_3 options 照片 (做照片 is a real job phrase, e.g. a photographer working in the city) and 房子 (做房子 can mean building houses) are both defensibly correct, which breaks the rule against defensibly correct distractors. B level_3 option 工作 ('这种工作会亏钱') is arguable. The other blocks looked sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90327. The gloss '购买和出售；生意' matches 90327's '买卖…也指做生意'. Sentences overlap: '这笔买卖赚了不少钱' is a single transaction, which 90327 also covers, and '这家小店的买卖一直很稳' is a business use that 90327's definition also covers. The two senses cannot be taught separately.

definition: 死者留下的财产；也指前人留下的文化成果。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝：核心本身的义项边界有问题。定义包含两个义项，其中财产义与90345重复，句子集也不是单一义项。在决定收窄或并入之前，修补块毫无意义。上述各条问题在最终保留的版本中都需要修复。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合在一起：「死者留下的财产」与90345的义项重复，「前人留下的文化成果」则是另一义项。句子集中，第1、4、7、9句是财产义，其余为文化义，因此不符合「每句只用一个义项」的要求。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「这是一本宝贵的遗产。」在文化义下成立（一部珍贵典籍即可视为前人留下的遗产），所谓错误句并不错。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「继承过叔叔的一本遗产」若遗产是一部书，则成立。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「他完成了父亲的遗产」在文化义下可读作完成父亲未竟的作品，因此并非错误句。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「他一生都遵守祖父的遗产」属边界句，在文化义下接近可接受。

definition: 没出问题或没受伤害；也指没有事情要做。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because its core mixes two senses and duplicates 90369. Only sentences 3, 4 and 7 use the 无事可做 sense. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 5 and 9 use the 没出事 sense. The blocks A level_3, B level_3, B level_6, B level_7 and B synonym_antonym are all built on the 没出事 sense, so the 无事可做 sense has almost no block coverage. Regenerate it as a separate sense, then re-run the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 前半“没出问题或没受伤害”与 90369“没有麻烦，也没有出问题”为同一义项，属重复；后半“没有事情要做”才是独立义项。两个义项混在同一条目中。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1].explanation: 解释称“没有事”指没出问题，与本条目“无事可做”的定义不符。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].text: “这部电影没有事，很无聊。”中“没有事”可读作“片中没有情节发生”，字面上不一定错误。

definition: 用手指点击并按压屏幕或按键。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate split. The extra content is aspect and 按住, not a distinct sense of 点按. Its sentences are otherwise valid for the 90383 sense, so their content belongs under 90383.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: Duplicate of 90383. The 可持续或重复 qualifier is aspect or repetition, not a separate lexical sense. Sentence 0 and sentence 4 use 按住 for the hold, which shows 点按 alone does not carry the hold meaning.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他用抹布点按桌子 is defensibly acceptable as dabbing with a cloth, so it is not a clean wrong sentence.

definition: 玩牌、玩游戏时，排在你后面的那个人。
reviewer_notes: The exercises themselves are clean: level_3 A/B, level_6 A/B and level_7 A/B all have a single error, valid correct indices, and no defensibly correct distractors. The sentence set could be salvaged into 90398 if the curator wants it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 90398's card-game meaning. 90398 defines 下家 as the next player in a game or the next party in a deal, which covers 玩牌 and 玩游戏. Sentences repeat: 90397 #9 '下家笑着把牌放在桌上' vs 90398 #7 '我的下家笑着把牌放在桌上'; 90397 #8 '他是我的下家，我出完他就出' vs 90398 #2 '他是我的下家，该他出牌了'.

definition: 利用电话、电报、网络等传递消息；也指详细报道事实的新闻稿。
reviewer_notes: reject：核心是两个义项的合并，靠少数节点修补不可行。应重新生成为只含新闻稿义项（详细报道事实的新闻稿）的 sense。传递消息义项已由 90411 覆盖。核心中的 0-3、6-8 句属于新闻稿义项，可作为候选池复用。重新生成后需重算各块的 sentence 索引。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合并：“利用电话、电报、网络等传递消息”（即 90411）与“详细报道事实的新闻稿”。一个 sense 只能锁定一个义项。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样混入“用电话、网络传递消息”。; core.sentences[4], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[9]: 三句使用传递消息义项（“网络让通讯更方便”“他们靠网络保持通讯”“山里没有网络，通讯很困难”），属于漂移义项。; variants.B.level_6, variants.B.level_7, variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: B 的 level_6、level_7 与近反义块都锚定在 sentences[9]，即传递消息义项，因此 B 的锚点不成立。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences, variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences: 解释把“通讯”释义为“传递消息”，与新闻稿义项矛盾。

definition: 人死亡的委婉说法。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for duplication, not for the content of its blocks. The sentences and blocks read as sound on their own. If the team keeps this sense in place of 90445, also fix variants.B.level_3 option 毕业 (/variants/B/level_3/options/0). 爷爷毕业后，奶奶一个人住 can be read as a separation story, so it is a weak distractor in the anchor sentence. The plan would then need re-running, as noted for 90445.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义“人死亡的委婉说法”与 sense 90445 的“人死了，不再活着，这是一种好听的说法”描述同一义项（去世的委婉义），属于重复义项。

definition: 不与其他人或事物合在一起；独自。
reviewer_notes: Rejected rather than rewritten. The sense boundary with 90463 is structural, and patching would rewrite most blocks and sentences. The separate-handling sentences (0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9) are sound if the sense is kept, and the B level_6 correct sentence 9 is a good example. Could not run fat_seed_runner plan (no tools); active_levels include 2 with no block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss 独自 is the 90463 sense (只有一个人，不跟别人在一起). The two senses overlap structurally and the boundary is not usable. The definition should describe separate handling only.; core.sentences[1], core.sentences[3], core.sentences[6]: These sentences use 单独 as 独自/一个人 (单独和我谈一谈, 要单独行动, 不敢单独去见老板). They fit 90463, not the 分开处理 sense. Blocks depend on them: A level_6 correct uses [3]; B level_3 blank and B level_7 correct list use [6].; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这笔钱是他单独的积蓄” can mean savings held in a separate account, so it may be defensibly acceptable and not a clean wrong sentence.

definition: 尺寸比一般大的型号；也指一种体型大的低音铜管乐器。
reviewer_notes: 拒收。核心的义项混合无法仅靠补丁修复，几乎每个句子都要重写，因此应拆分为两个 sense 文档后重新生成。句 0 至 4 和句 9 属于尺寸义，与 90483 重复；句 5 至 8 属于乐器义。变体层面的其他问题（“身材很大号”干扰句、“这是一台大号的机器”作为错误句偏弱）也需要在拆分后重新检查。变体中已通过检查的内容包括：代号、大豪、打好 的最小对立对；“地”与“的”的错误；“把”量词错误；以及“吹一个大号”与“支”的错误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一个 sense_id 同时定义了两个义项：尺寸型号（大号的衣服、鞋、杯子等）和低音铜管乐器。尺寸义已由 90483 覆盖，两者重复；而且违反“每句只用一个义项”的要求。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样并列了两个义项，无法消歧，学习者也无法锁定具体义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他的身材很大号”用“大号”形容人的体型，口语中可能被接受，不宜作为确定的错误句（与 90483 的同类问题相同）。

definition: 军队中的普通成员；也指为正义事业奋斗的人。
reviewer_notes: 拒收。核心存在义项混合，不能只靠补丁修复，应拆分后重新生成。变体的其他检查：A 与 B 的 level_6 错误句全部是量词错误，没有测试练习名称所暗示的义项区分；level_3 的干扰项在语义上基本站得住。拆分后这些练习需要重新设计。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “军队中的普通成员；也指为正义事业奋斗的人”把字面的军人义与比喻义合在一个 sense 中，违反单义项要求。句 0、3、4、6、8 是军人义，句 1、2、5、7、9 是比喻义；军人义与 90547 重复。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同样并列了两个义项，无法为学习者锁定具体义项。; variants.A.level_1.options[3]: “战书”（shū）与“战士”（shì）的韵母和声调都不同，不是纯声调或单音位的最小对立对，不适合作为听音辨字的干扰项。

definition: 会面，多指正式的见面。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is redundant with 90557, not because of the individual blocks. Retire it or merge it into 90557. The remaining issues are listed only so that a retained sense is not copied from this one. The plan's active_levels also include 2 and 4 with no blocks, as in the other documents.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 90557. 会面，多指正式的见面 and 和重要的客人见面谈话 describe the same formal meeting, and every example here works for 90557. The sense split is not pedagogically real, so sense pinning cannot hold.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences: The three wrong sentences are the same as 90557 A level_6 (路上我会见了老同学, 周末我去医院会见生病的奶奶, 他去美国会见了一个月), only reordered. A and B level_1 options and B level_6 wrong sentences are also copied from 90557.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “两国代表昨天会见过一次。” has the same contestable 过-with-a-specific-time error as 90557 B level_7. If this sense is kept, the error is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “吵” is arguably meaning-compatible with 他们在大使馆正式___，没有记者 (a private quarrel without reporters). It is a risk for the 'no distractor fits' rule, not a clear failure.

definition: 说话人自己所在的国家。
reviewer_notes: reject 的理由：（1）与 90567 释义相同、用法相同，是重复义项；（2）其自身释义“所在”与其句子和解释互相矛盾。应保留 90567，删除本义项。若义项清单确实需要“说话人当前所在的国家”这一区分，应另行设计，句子须符合该释义。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“说话人自己所在的国家”与句子用法矛盾。句 0“他在外国工作，但很想念本国的家人”和句 6“留学生回到本国后”中，说话人并不在本国，本国指的是母国。句子实际用的是 90567 的义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[1].explanation: 解释称“本国指留学生自己的国家”，这是 90567 的义项，与本核心的“所在”释义相悖。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0].explanation: 解释以“身在法国时要说当地的风俗”为前提，即本国不指说话人所在之地，这与核心释义“说话人自己所在的国家”直接冲突。level_6 的全部 wrong_sentences 解释都有同样问题。

definition: 计算；谋划；也指计策。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core spans at least three senses (计算/计入, 计较, 计策 as a noun), which a patch cannot repair. Recommended split: 计 (动词, 计算/计入), 计 (动词, 计较), 计 (名词, 计策). Each needs its own document and plan. Overlaps heavily with sense 90605 on the 计算 sense. synonym_antonym_match blocks are declined (no_relation) and left unchanged. Level_1 options were checked and are sound.
reviewer_issues: core.pos and core.definition: The sense mixes 计算/谋划 (verb) with 计策 (noun). Sentences 4 to 7 use 计 as a noun counter (一计, 中了我们的计, 这一计), yet pos is 动词.; core.sentences[0], core.sentences[3], core.sentences[8]: The 计较 sense (不计回报 / 不计代价 / 不计别人的辛苦) is not in the definition. These sentences drift from 计算/谋划/计策.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index (3) and variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: The level_6 correct sentence 「他想救朋友，不计代价」 is the 计较 sense, outside the defined sense, so the item tests the wrong meaning.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「他对朋友很计」 has an explanation that admits it uses a different sense (计较), and 「很计」 is ungrammatical. It is not a clean error for this sense.

definition: 副词，表示出乎意料。

definition: 出售是把东西拿给别人，别人给钱。

definition: 可以直接使用的货币；手头的钱。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: Merges two senses: the 叹词 surprise sense (identical to 91851) and the 拟声词 crying sense. definition: 即将到来。

(2) B level_6 wrong sentence 「人群已经将至，广场上只剩下几个人。」: the explanation about people leaving is weak; the error is the 「已经」 + 「将至」 aspect clash, and the explanation should say so.

definition: 以国王为最高统治者的国家，也比喻某种事物聚集的领域。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core itself is unusable, not because of a patchable block. The sense definition 'a country ruled by a king, also a metaphor for a domain' overlaps sense 91971's literal definition, and the B variant is anchored on the literal sense. Sentences 0-4, 7 and 8 use the figurative sense and are good seeds for a clean figurative sense. The A variant's L1 decline, synonym decline and L7 are otherwise sound. Recommend re-extracting the figurative sense or merging it with 91971 before rebuilding the blocks.
reviewer_issues: core.sentences[5], core.sentences[6], core.sentences[9]: Three of ten sentences use the literal sense 'a kingdom with a king' (这个国家以前是一个小王国 / 王国的国王很爱他的人民 / 很久以前，有一个很大的王国). That is sense 91971, not the figurative 'domain of a kind of thing' sense this sense is meant to teach. The definition bundles both senses, so the sense is not pinned.; variants.B.level_3, variants.B.level_6, variants.B.level_7, variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: The B variant is anchored on literal sentences 6 and 9, so it tests the literal sense and not the one the sense claims to teach. Level_6 correct sentence 9 and the wrong sentence '有一个很大的王国，却没有任何国王' both depend on the literal reading.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 墓地 is not clearly wrong. '这里是玩具的墓地' is a recognisable figurative phrase (a toy graveyard). The anchor sentence never states joy outright, so a learner could defensibly pick it.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: '这个部落没有国王，却是一个王国' is self-contradictory, and its explanation says the correct word is 共和国. A tribe is not a 国家, so 共和国 does not fit. The error explanation misdirects the learner.

definition: 里面没有东西的；也指天空或没有内容的。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges three senses: 里面没有东西 (container), 天空 (sky), and 没有内容 (no substance). The fingerprint pins only the container sense, so the document violates one-sense-per-document. The 天空 sense is not illustrated by any sentence.; core.sense_fingerprint: The sense duplicates sense 91983 (空 = 里面什么也没有 vs 里面没有东西). Two sense entries for one meaning would double-count the same exercises.; sentences[6]: 这篇文章内容很空，没有什么新意 uses the no-content sense, which the fingerprint does not describe. It is the anchor for the B level_3 cloze, so the blank tests a different sense than the one taught.

definition: 内心是你心里想的和感觉到的。

definition: 变成了；也表示事情办好了、可以了。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as one sense. Its definition merges 变成了 (already taught by 92359) with 办成了 / 可以了, and 3 of its 10 sentences are 变成 usages. Fixing this by patch would mean rewriting the definition, three sentences, and the B-variant blocks, so the whole sense should be re-authored. Sentences 0–5 and 8 (好，就这样，成了！; 这件事终于成了。; 这事成了吗？; 他一说，我们的计划就成了。; 再加点盐就成了。; 成了，就放这儿吧。; 他们的合同谈了很久，今天总算成了。) are usable as the 办成 sense if regenerated. Lower-confidence point: 这次会议下午成了 (A level_6) is also borderline, since 会议成了 can mean the meeting came off.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition bundles two senses: 变成了 and 事情办好了、可以了. The 变成 half duplicates sense 92359, so one sense record covers two meanings.; core.sentences[6], core.sentences[7], core.sentences[9]: The 变成 usages (他成了公司的经理; 这个孩子成了大明星; 这回他总算成了冠军) belong to 92359's sense, not to the 办成 meaning this record should teach.; variants.B.level_3: The cloze is built on core.sentences[6], a 变成 usage, and its explanations (吃/喝/扔) refer to 身份变化. These go stale once the sentence changes.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这批庄稼都成了，可以收割了 is defensibly acceptable colloquial Chinese (庄稼成了 = the crop came good / ripened). Its own explanation concedes a different sense, so it is not a clean wrong sentence.

definition: 右是吃饭拿筷子的那一边。
reviewer_notes: 句子本身都是“右侧”义，可以并入 92574 复用。计划中 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但没有对应 block；本次无法运行 planner，需重新确认。

definition: 两地之间相向开出；也指纸张的一种尺寸。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core is unusable: it merges a verb sense and a paper-size sense under 动词. No patch can make one document correct for both. Split the sense, then regenerate the blocks from the plan for each new sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: One sense combines two distinct meanings: vehicles travelling toward each other (verb) and a paper size (noun or adjective). A sense document must describe one sense, and this one cannot be used for both.; core.pos: 動詞 does not fit the paper-size usage (e.g. 对开的纸, 这张报纸是对开的), which is attributive or nominal.; variants.B: Every B sentence uses the paper-size meaning, which the core as written does not describe as the sense being taught.; variants.A: A's vehicle-sense sentences duplicate 92615 almost verbatim (e.g. 每天中午，两列货车在这两个城市之间对开 vs 92615's 每天早上，两班车从两个城市对开).

definition: 骗人就是说假话，让别人相信不是真的事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a core. It duplicates 92634, and its own wrong sentences borrow the sister sense. Recommended action: merge 92633 into 92634 (its definition is a subset) and regenerate the blocks from the merged document. Non-core observations for whoever rebuilds it: the A level_7 incorrect sentence 他以前骗人过 is near-identical to 92634 B level_7 那个人以前骗人过; and 很骗人 as a predicate is colloquial but drifts toward a 'misleading' meaning. I did not run the plan runner here.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The core is a strict subset of sense 92634 (用虚假的言语或行为使人上当). 说假话让别人相信 is one form of 用虚假的言语使人上当, so the two senses cannot be pinned apart. Many sentences fit both, for example 这个广告上的话都是骗人的 and 这种网站是骗人的. Sense pinning fails at the core level.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 他躺在床上骗人，闭着眼睛装睡 is a deception by act, which is the 92634 sense. It is not a clear wrong use of this sense, so the distractor is contaminated by the sister sense.; variants.A.level_3.options[1..3]: 其实是写字的 is defensible: 写字的 means a writer, so 写字 fits the frame 他说自己是医生，其实是___的. 下棋 and 跑步 can also be read as occupational or identity contrasts. The explanations claiming 毫不相干 and 搭配不上 are false.; variants.B.level_3.options[2..3]: 我没有来，我昨天真的去了图书馆 reads as a coherent alibi, so 来 is defensibly correct. The 进 explanation (missing object, so it is wrong) is overstated.

definition: 比喻事物发展的主要方面或趋势；江河的主要水流。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项不清，无法靠 patch 修复，故判为 reject。需先决定是否拆分：江河义与比喻义应分别成为独立 sense。比喻义（主要方面或趋势）与 92909（最多人选的）高度重叠，需一并判断两者的边界。拆分前不应修改任何 block。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一 sense_id 合并了两个义项：江河的主要水流（具体）与比喻的主要方面或趋势（抽象）。; core.sentences[4,5,6,8,9]: 这五句用的是比喻义（主要方面或趋势），与其余江河义句子（0、1、2、3、7）并存，句子未锁定单一义项。; variants.A (level_3, level_6, level_7, synonym_antonym_match): A 变体全部取江河义（长江的主流、主流很宽、一座主流等）。; variants.B (level_3, level_6, level_7, synonym_antonym_match): B 变体取比喻义（看事情要看主流、技术创新成了行业发展的主流），与 A 变体所教的义项不同，两个变体并未测同一义项。; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: 支流是江河义主流的部分（汇入主流的小河），两者是部分与整体的关系，并非反义，正确答案不满足所给的 antonym 关系。; variants.B.synonym_antonym_match: 支流作“次要方面”解的反义关系只在比喻义下成立，且依赖于拆分前的合并义项，当前无法确认。

definition: 迹象是让人看出事情快要发生的一点点小样子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 92928. If the team merges, carry over the fixes above into 92928 where they apply. The plan's active_levels include 2, 4 and 9 with no blocks; confirm with the planner.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of 92928. 92927 is “让人看出事情快要发生的小样子”, a subset of 92928's “已经发生或将要发生的隐约现象”. Both cover the same sense of 迹象.; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “说话时有一股不高兴的味道” is idiomatic (figurative 味道), so 味道 fits the blank grammatically and in meaning. The explanation that it cannot be used is false.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “向我发出了要走的迹象” is weakly wrong. 发出 with 迹象 is used in news prose (发出复苏迹象), and the explanation that 迹象 cannot be emitted is overstated.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “天气预报说明天的迹象是晴天” is borderline. 迹象 can mean a forecast sign, so the wrongness rests only on the 是…的 construction.; core.morphological_forms: The forms “个” and “种” are bare measure words, not forms of 迹象. The 眼神 documents use 一个眼神 instead.

definition: 一年中农作物收成的好坏。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 92969, which is the sense to keep. The other issues are recorded so they can be fixed if the sense is reinstated under a different meaning. I could not run the plan command (no tool access).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. '一年中农作物收成的好坏' has the same meaning as sense 92969 ('这一年庄稼长得好不好'), and the fingerprints are nearly identical. Keeping both would train the same item twice and split one meaning into two documents.; variants.A.level_1.options: Same neutral-tone leak as 92969: all distractors carry a full-tone 成, so the answer is identified by the second syllable alone.; variants.B.level_1: B declines level_1 with no_minimal_pairs while A supplies n/l and tone minimal pairs for the same headword and audio. The two variants are inconsistent.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: '这一年是一场好年成' keeps the taught sense and is wrong only for its classifier 场. It is not a wrong-sense distractor.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: '他这一季的年成很好' keeps the harvest sense and is wrong only in time scope. It is ambiguous with the correct answer.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: '今年的年成很厚' keeps the harvest sense and is wrong only by collocation. It is not a sense distractor.

definition: 根据别人的说法；听人说。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so the blocks were not patched. The level_7 A corrected sentence and the level_6 B wrong sentences look sound, but they are moot once the sense is dropped.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 92991 (根据别人的说法；听人说 vs 据说是听别人这样说). Two senses for one meaning give two defensible answers to the same item, so the ladder cannot separate them.

definition: 文物是很久以前留下来的有用的老东西。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 92994, which has the correct definition (历史上遗留下来的具有价值的物品). Keep 92994. The plan also lists levels 2, 4 and 9 as active with no blocks; reconcile after the corrected sense is built.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 文物 is defined as 有用的老东西 (useful old things). That misdescribes the word, which means cultural relics valued for their historical or cultural worth, not usefulness.; variants.B.level_3 (anchor sentence 6: 这件文物看起来又旧又脏，其实很有用): The anchor is built on the wrong sense of usefulness. Under that reading, 废品, 垃圾 and 废弃物 all fit defensibly (things that look like junk but are useful), so the item has multiple correct answers.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 这些文物没什么用，我们都扔掉吧 is acceptable under the stated definition, so it is not a clean wrong sentence.

definition: 测量是用尺子等东西，量出有多长、多大。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，不能单独作为一个义项使用，故整体拒收。93018 的定义更宽、覆盖本词条的全部用法。本词条的例句可供 93018 复用，但不要保留两个词条。
reviewer_issues: /core/definition: 与 93018 重复：“用尺子”只是“用仪器或工具”的一种，两个词条测的是同一个义项，例句与选项无法区分。

definition: 开始建造大型建筑或工程。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 93059. Other blocks are mostly sound (A and B level_3 options have one correct answer each; A level_7 error is real; A and B level_6 wrong sentences are wrong). Only B level_7 is clearly defective. If the merge keeps this sense's blocks instead of 93059's, re-run the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 93059. Same verb, same 'start building' meaning, and the difference is only scale. Teaching both would present one meaning twice.; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「国家决定西部兴建一条新铁路」 is grammatical. A location as subject of 兴建 is idiomatic in news style (e.g. 北京兴建了一座新机场), so the 在 is optional. It is not an error.

definition: 古代的士兵；象棋中的小子；也指死亡。
reviewer_notes: The core cannot be patched in place. The sense id covers three senses, and the chess sense already belongs to 93089. Rebuild from a single soldier sense, and give the 去世 sense its own id if it is needed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 同一 sense_id 合并了三个义项：古代士兵、象棋之卒、去世。sentences 3, 4, 5 为去世义，6, 7 为象棋义，违反一个义项原则。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index (sentence 3): 正确句「古书里说，这位老将卒于七十岁」是去世义，不是锁定的士兵义。; variants.B.level_3 (sentence 6) and variants.B.level_7 (sentences 6, 7): 引用的象棋义句子与本 sense 不符。

definition: 国内战争是一个国家里面的人自己打起来。
reviewer_notes: Core is a duplicate sense, so no local patch is possible. If the sense inventory deliberately keeps 93105 separate, its definition and sense_fingerprint must describe a distinct meaning, and plan must be re-run.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 93106. Both describe a war inside one country between its own people or factions, with the same POS and semantic class. The only difference is colloquial vs. written wording, which is a register difference, not a separate sense. The learner would be taught the same meaning twice.

definition: 大类是把东西分成几大堆，其中的一堆。
reviewer_notes: Core is a duplicate sense, so no local patch is possible. Even if kept, two items would have needed fixing: A level_6 wrong sentences 老师给了我们大类的作业 and 老师说，这次大类很重要 are arguably acceptable readings of 大类 (major-category homework, important category), so they would fail the 'clearly wrong' rule. The synonym antonym 小类 fits 93116's hierarchical sense better than 93115's 'pile' sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 93116. 把东西分成几大堆的一堆 and 按性质划分的较大的类别 name the same referent: one major category from a sort. The 中性 vs. 书面语 split is register only, so the learner would be taught the same meaning twice.

definition: 地钱是长在湿湿的地上的一种矮矮的绿色小草。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，故整体拒收，未给出补丁。未修改的其他问题（仅供合并时参考）：B 的 level_6 错句解释称“只”多用于动物或成对的东西，不准确（“一只碗”“一只船”均可）；A 的 level_3 干扰项“蘑菇”仅靠“绿绿的”颜色排除，较弱。未运行 plan 脚本（无工具）；该 sense 若被拒收，plan 无需重新生成。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93136 指同一植物（同一 lemma，同样生长于阴湿地面或石头上，例句语境也相同），没有可供学习者区分的义项。“小草”也不准确：地钱是苔藓植物（93136 已正确定义），并非草本植物。

definition: 工业国是有很多工厂的国家。
reviewer_notes: 因与 93140 重复而整体舍弃，故不作修补。若日后保留该义项，还需注意：A 组 level_6 错句“这种工业国卖得很好”可被理解为“这类工业国的产品卖得好”，并不明显错误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与义项 93140 同义：二者都指“工业国”，只是释义角度不同。两个义项会让学习者学两遍同一个意思。释义“有很多工厂的国家”也只是工业国的一个外在特征，不如 93140 的“以工业生产为国民经济主体”准确。

definition: 始终一样，没有变化。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 93149. The problems listed (drifted sentences, acceptable-as-wrong options, the false 'not the same as others' explanation) are the same ones fixed in the 93149 patches, so they should not be carried into the merged sense. A level_3 and B level_3 options are fine. The 始终如一的支持 → 地 error in A level_7 is real if the sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 93149 (始终一样，没有变化 vs 从头到尾都一样，没有变). Two senses that cannot be taught apart.; core.sentences[2]: 「他言行如一」 uses the word-and-deed sense, not 'unchanged over time'. It is a correct example in A level_7.; core.sentences[3]: 「他表里如一」 uses the inner-and-outer sense, not the stated sense. It is the correct sentence for A level_6 (correct_sentence_index 3).; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「全班的意见如一了」 is acceptable. 意见如一 is the 'unanimous' usage, so it is not wrong, and the explanation (如一 does not mean 'make views consistent') is false.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「大家的步调要如一」 is acceptable. 步调如一 is standard usage meaning 'in step', so it is not wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「我的成绩和他如一」 is borderline. It can be read as 'identical', which is acceptable.

definition: 抚养孩子使成长。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 93165, so no patches. If the sense were kept, these would also need fixing: A L3 option 「送别」has a false explanation, since 「把我们兄弟送别」is grammatical and only semantically off. B L3 has the same 讨好 and 挑选 problems as 93165. B L6 wrong sentences 「这项政策带大了当地的经济」and 「这次培训让他的水平带大了不少」are copied from 93165. Other content is clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 「抚养孩子使成长」and the fingerprint 「抚养孩子使其成长」restate the same meaning as sense 93165 (从小照顾一个孩子直到他长大). The sentences overlap heavily, so one meaning would be drilled twice.

definition: 投资家是把钱放到好地方，让钱变多的人。
reviewer_notes: 因与 93168 重复而整体舍弃，故不作修补。若日后保留，还需修正：A 组 level_3 的“乞丐把钱放到好地方”语法通顺，也可以指存钱，不能算明确错误；B 组 level_3 的“厨师看过很多公司”也可能成立（如承包餐饮的厨师），需替换。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与义项 93168 同义：二者都指以资金投入并获取收益的人，只是表述不同。两者会让学习者学到两遍同一个意思。

definition: 从水路上岸；也指进入某个平台或系统。
reviewer_notes: The core is a duplicate, so no patch can make it usable. If a log-in sense is wanted, author a new sense with its own sentences and check current usage of 登陆 vs 登录. Furigana is present on most sentences here but absent on others, which is inconsistent. That is moot because the sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition ‘从水路上岸’ is the same sense as 93193. The second clause ‘进入某个平台或系统’ has no sentence, and no block exercises it. All ten sentences are ship-to-shore paraphrases of 93193's sentences, e.g. “士兵们乘小船登陆海岛” vs 93193's “士兵们从小船登陆海岛”, and “他们等天亮再登陆，避开了巡逻队” vs 93193's “他们等天亮再登陆”.

definition: 在大型组织中负责日常事务的主要负责人。
reviewer_notes: One of the two must go. Its blocks are otherwise sound, but that does not rescue a duplicate sense. Its sentences (联合国秘书长, 基金会, 学会) could be merged into 93195's sentence pool in a later rebuild. If the team wants a second 秘书长 sense, it must be genuinely different, for example a government-office role, with its own sentences. That is a new document, not a patch.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 93195. ‘在大型组织中负责日常事务的主要负责人’ and 93195's ‘大团体里管事的重要的人’ describe the same head-of-large-organization sense, and the sentences draw on the same usage.

definition: 竞赛是大家比一比，看谁做得最好。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as a separate sense because it duplicates 93200. Content checked before rejecting: the level_1 decline (no_minimal_pairs) is correct because 径赛 is an exact homophone. The level_3, level_6, level_7 and synonym_antonym_match blocks are internally correct, with exactly one correct option per block and no defensibly-correct distractor. Those blocks would be moot if the sense is dropped.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Sense 93199 duplicates sense 93200. Its definition (大家比一比，看谁做得最好), fingerprint, and all ten sentences describe the same sense as 93200 (在一定范围内比较技能、成绩的活动). The split teaches one sense twice.; plan.active_levels: The plan lists levels 2 and 4 as active, but neither variant A nor B has a level_2 or level_4 block.

definition: 因战乱、灾害等失去家园而流离失所的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for redundancy only. The blocks otherwise check out against the plan (level_3 sentence 0 and 6, level_6 indices 3 and 9, level_7 indices 0-2 and 6,7,9), and the distractors are reasonable. No patches are proposed because the core should not ship twice.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 93237 (难民 = a person who lost home to war or disaster). The definitions and fingerprints are near-identical, and the sentences overlap in meaning. This is a duplicate, not a distinct sense.

definition: 网络游戏用语，指提高段位或积分。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for sentence quality. Anchors, plan indices and single-correct options otherwise check out. If this sense were kept, its level_1 option 上方 has the same two-phoneme defect as 93241. The same level_4 gap applies: 了 and 过 forms exist with no block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 93241 (a rise in game score or rank). Two senses with no distinct meaning teach nothing extra and split the learner's review.

definition: 盯是眼睛一直看着，不动。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate. The definition and fingerprint (眼睛一直看着，不动) restate sense 93284 (目不转睛地注视), and both sentence banks show the same fixed-gaze use. Retire one of the two in the sense inventory; 93284 carries the standard gloss. The other blocks read clean apart from the 拆 explanation.
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_3.options[3]: The explanation for 拆 cites “拆着电视看”, a phrase that does not appear in the cloze sentence.

definition: 真诚是说真话，心里想什么就说什么。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 93286 (真实诚恳，没有虚假). 说真话，心里怎么想就怎么说 is the same sense focused on speech. Its sentence bank and antonym 虚伪 overlap heavily with 93286, and 93286 carries the standard gloss. Keep 93286 and retire this one. The blocks checked otherwise have one clear correct answer each.

definition: 食物味道好，吃起来可口。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，故拒绝。其余块（B 块三个块及 A 的 level_3、synonym_antonym_match）未发现问题。
reviewer_issues: core.sense_fingerprint: 与 93397 实为同一义项（食物味道好、好吃）。两个义项会把同一含义教两遍，学习者无法区分。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这杯咖啡很好吃”在口语中常见且可接受（与奶茶同类），不是干净的错误句。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “太好吃了了”是重复语气词的错误，位置在“好吃”之后；解释却称“句末的了”，描述不准确。

definition: 向远处看；朝某个方向看。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，故拒绝。若流水线要求保留，请先确认 93434 与 93433 的义项边界，并在合并时保留 93433 的题块。其余块的干扰项在正文中站得住，未发现错误句或误导性解释。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “向远处或某个方向看”与 93433 的“用眼睛往远处看”实为同一义项，例句（如“站在楼顶，可以望到很远的地方”）也与 93433 的内容重合。

definition: 前夕是一个大日子来到的前一天晚上。
reviewer_notes: Core is not a distinct sense, so no patches. For the record, if this sense were kept: variants.B.level_7 incorrect sentence '春运前夕了' is not clearly wrong, because '现在已经是春节前夕了' is grammatical, so the explanation that 前夕 cannot take 了 is false. 93436 survives this rejection.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 93436. '大日子来到的前一天晚上' and '重大日子或事件到来之前的晚上或时期' teach the same meaning, and the sentence sets overlap. Sentences such as 旅行前夕 and 搬家前夕 are not 'the day before a big day'. Two senses for one meaning will break sense pinning.

definition: 本来就；原本就是。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject 的原因是与 93437 重复，并非其他内容有误。若团队决定保留本义项，需要做以下修补：A.level_3 把“诚然”换为“马上”；B.level_6 替换“那座山本就很快会变成平地”；B.level_1 与 B.level_7 按 93437 的方式修改。两者择一保留即可。
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 与 93437 为同一义项（本来、原本就如此），两个义项会产生内容重复的练习。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]（诚然）: “这件事诚然不难，你别太紧张”语法通顺、语义相合，仅因语域被排除，不算明确错误选项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “那座山本就很快会变成平地”可读作“原本就打算很快变平”，不是明确错句。; variants.B.level_1.options[1..3]: 本集、本局、本节与本就同时在声调和韵母上不同，听力辨识度低。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 说明称“了”应放在句末，但修正句中没有“了”。

definition: 人在水中依靠四肢划动而前进。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on sense duplication, not content. Sentences and blocks are otherwise clean: the level_3 and level_6 distractors are wrong, the level_7 error and corrected indices check out, and the level_6 wrong sentence 他用游泳的方法写完了报告 duplicates 93441's. If the pipeline keeps this document instead of 93441, reconcile the two first.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Defines the same sense as 93441 (在水中用手脚或四肢划动前进). The fingerprint also overlaps 93441's. Two sense documents for one sense is a duplicate, not a second sense.

definition: 立刻；当场。
reviewer_notes: Core is not a distinct sense, so no patches. Choosing 93447 over 93448 is a judgment call between two identical senses; 93447 is kept because its fingerprint is more specific. Its L6 wrong sentence '你这次来得真即时' has the same kind of problem as 93447 A, so the same concern applies if it is ever reused.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: '立刻；当场' duplicates sense 93447 ('马上，不用等'). Both are the adverb 'immediately', and the fingerprints overlap almost entirely.

definition: 地级是国家把地方分成的一个大小等级。
reviewer_notes: 核心为重复 sense，而非句子质量问题，因此不做补丁。若编辑决定保留本条，需注意：A level_3 的挖空句“省下面是地级，地级下面是县级”保留了第二个“地级”，给出了答案线索；A level_7 的错误在量词“条”修饰“地级市”中的“市”，并未落在“地级”本身上；B level_7 的“漏掉是”属于书面语中的判断句错误，但口语中“我北京人”式省略常见，判定较弱。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 sense 93482 描述的是同一个义项（省级与县级之间的行政等级），同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id。两套练习会对同一答案给出相互竞争的判定，且 sense_fingerprint 与 93482 几乎相同。

definition: 完了是做完了，也可以说事情糟了。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因此不做补丁。93496 为同一双义项的重复，应一并拆分。若编辑决定保留本条的素材，需注意：B level_6 的错误句“雨终于完了，我们可以出门了。”实际使用的是结束义，且“雨完了”是可接受的说法，不能作为错误句，只是用词偏好不同；B level_7 的“晚会不完了”被标为否定错误，但“不完了”在口语中可表示“停不下来”（如“这事儿不完了”），判定有争议；A level_1 的干扰项“万里”在韵母和声调上都不同，属于较弱的干扰项。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 一个 sense 同时包含两个义项：“做完了”（结束义）与“事情糟了”（口语糟糕义）。句子 0–4、8 使用糟糕义，5–7、9 使用结束义，违反“每句只用一个义项”的核心要求。sense_fingerprint 也同时列出两者。

definition: 结束；（口语）表示事情糟糕、没有希望。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因此不做补丁。若保留素材，需注意：B level_3 的干扰项“举行”可能成立（演出举行中有观众中途离场），不是干净的错误选项；B level_7 的“展览不完了”与 93495 同样存在“不完了”的口语用法争议；A level_3 的干扰项“放映”搭配不当，但其解释成立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93495 相同，将“结束”与“口语糟糕义”合并为一个 sense。句子 0、1、5、6、8 用结束义，2、3、4、7、9 用糟糕义，无法保证单义。

definition: 在某人领导或指挥之下的人。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝原因：义项与 93565 重复，不构成独立的可教义项。若单独评估，另有问题：A 级3 的“仆人”以“旧式主仆色彩”排除，但“这家公司有二十个仆人”语义牵强，属于弱干扰项。其余部分（级1、B 级3、B 级6、A 级7 的“三个个手下”、B 级7 的“二十个手下们”）基本合格。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93565 同义：“在某人领导或指挥之下的人员”与“听你的话、替你做事的人”指同一个下属义。“人员”与“人”不构成义项区分，学习者会遇到两组同义练习。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “裁判对他手下留情”使用的是固定语“手下留情”，此处“手下”并非该义项。其“错误”来自句意自相矛盾，而非“手下”的误用，不符合标注的干扰原因。

definition: 创意是一个新鲜的好想法，别人以前没有想到过。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 93568, which should survive. If the lexicon owner keeps this sense instead, also fix A level_3 options[1] (房子) and re-run plan. Its other blocks (A level_6, A level_7, B level_3, B level_6, B level_7) checked clean. The level_1 decline is acceptable because 创意 has no real minimal pair. No source field, so nothing is mined.
reviewer_issues: core (whole sense): 与 93568 实为同一义项。“别人以前没有想到过的新鲜好想法”与“新颖独特的想法或构思”几乎没有区别。同一义项被切成两条，两条的练习句可以互换，违反义项锁定。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: “我有一个好房子，想告诉你。”语法与语义均可接受（可以告诉别人找到的房子），房子 在锚句中同样说得通，违反“干扰项不得同样正确”的要求。其解释“告诉接的是想法、消息，不接房子”也不准确。

definition: 原因；缘由。
reviewer_notes: Rejected for duplication, not for block content. The blocks otherwise look sound: the level_3 distractors fail the cloze, the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for the stated reasons, and the level_7 errors (一把, 们) are single-error. Sense 93571 is kept as the survivor; see its notes.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 93571 (事情为什么会这样的原因 vs 原因；缘由). There is no distinguishing sense, so teaching both would drill the same word twice.

definition: 每月出版的报纸或每月提交的报告。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as written because it duplicates part of 93605. Level_1 declined (no_minimal_pairs), not reviewed. Level_3 distractors in A and B otherwise fail for this sense. Fix: split the senses, then regenerate the sentence set and the level_6 and level_7 blocks for whichever sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “每月出版的报纸或每月提交的报告” includes the report meaning, which is the entire sense of 93605. The two sense records are not separable, so the sense is not distinct.; core.sentences: Sentences 3 (他每月五号把月报交给经理), 7 (请你在月底前把月报做好) and arguably 5 and 8 use the report sense of 93605, not the publication sense.; variants.A.level_6: The correct sentence (index 3, 他每月五号把月报交给经理) is a report-sense use. It would also be correct for 93605, so it does not discriminate this sense.; variants.B.level_7: The corrected sentence (我的月报已经交给经理了) is a report-sense use.

definition: 本来的样子；真实自然、不加修饰。
reviewer_notes: Duplicate of 93613. Level_1 declined (no_minimal_pairs), not reviewed. The other blocks have a single correct option and sound distractors for this meaning. Reject is for the redundant core. If 93613 is kept, this record should be retired.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “本来的样子；真实自然、不加修饰” restates 93613 (“一点不假，本来的样子”). Both fingerprints describe the same meaning, so the two records are not separable senses.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “他的英语说得很本真” can be read as natural, unpretentious speech, which is the same sense as the correct sentence 小孩说话很本真. It is not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_7: 他露出了本真笑容 is only marginally ungrammatical (two-syllable adjective before a noun without 的). The error is arguable.

definition: 消防是预防火灾和灭火。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝原因是与 93656 重复，不是因为句子有问题；所有例句本身可用。若策展人改留本义项而不留 93656，需先处理上述问题并合并定义。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93656 是同一义项（预防和灭火，词性相同，例句同为名词用法）。定义“消防是预防火灾和灭火。”以词目自我定义，不是合格释义。; core.pos: 标注为动词，但全部例句和 sense_fingerprint 都是名词用法，而 level_6 解释又称“消防”是名词，三处自相矛盾。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “他十年前开始消防”在动词义下（“预防和扑灭火灾”）可以成立，不是干净的错误句；解释称“消防”不能作动词，与标注词性冲突。; variants.B.level_1: 以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃，但 A 的 level_1 中的校方、小房、效仿与“消防”只差声调，存在最小对立对。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 称“了解”的对象必须用“对……”引出，这不成立：“他很了解消防”合乎语法，错误在于宾语被提到“很”前且无介词引出。

definition: 会党是很多人偷偷聚在一起的一个团体。
reviewer_notes: 因核心不可用而拒绝，因此不做修补。若日后决定保留，以下问题也需要处理：(1) B 的 level_1 拒绝（no_minimal_pairs）不成立，会堂、会场、会长、回荡均为真实干扰项，A 已用；(2) plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但 blocks 中没有这些块，其中 level_4 需要 morphological_forms（一个会党、会党成员）对应的形式，level_9 为 word_family；(3) A 的 level_3 句 0 中，“公园”作为干扰项略有可辩护性，因为“偷偷见面”在公园并非不可能。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93658 实为同一义项：两者都是“偷偷聚集/秘密结社的团体”，93658 只多了“旧时民间”的时代限定。本义项的所有练习在 93658 中同样成立，学习者无法区分两个义项，两个练习的答案也会互相冲突。

definition: 经济改革是把国家管钱和做买卖的办法改一改。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝原因是与 93670 重复。93670 的释义更正式，且不以词目自我定义，因此保留它。上述句子层面问题若要保留本义项则需修正。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93670 是同一义项（经济改革，制度层面的变革）。定义“把国家管钱和做买卖的办法改一改”口语化且以词目自我定义。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: 正确句“经济改革是什么意思？”是元语言提问，没有展示该义项的实际用法；同一句又被用作 synonym_antonym 的依据句。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 称“了”不能紧跟宾语“经济改革”，规则过于绝对；“她研究经济改革了十年了”的错误并不干净，不能作为确定的错误句。

definition: 自由行是自己安排路线，去外地玩。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a dedupe decision, not for content: the sentences and blocks are otherwise clean. Keep 93698 as the survivor because its definition is more precise. For the merge: pos is 名词, but several sentences use 自由行 as a verb (去云南自由行, 去日本自由行, 一个人自由行, 一起自由行). Also, morphological_forms lists 次, a measure word, which is not a form of the lemma.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 93698. Both describe the same meaning (a self-arranged, non-group trip), with the same pos, semantic_class and usages. Two senses for one meaning produce duplicate exercises.

definition: 评选是大家比一比，选出最好的。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a dedupe decision, not for content. The blocks are otherwise sound: the distractors (排版, 熨烫, 修剪, 播种, 唱, 煮) do not fit, and the level_7 errors are real. 93710 is retained as the surviving sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 93710. Both define 评选 as comparing and choosing the best or excellent item, with the same pos, semantic_class and usages. 投票 in the fingerprint names a method, not a distinct sense.

definition: 何时是问是什么时候。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项重复，不予修补。若人工决定保留本 sense，B 级 6 中「他想坐何时的车去北京？」（「何时的车」可理解为「几点的车」）与「桌上的苹果是何时的？」（「何时的」可表示年代或来源）都不能确定为错误句，需要替换。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93742 为同一义项（疑问代词，询问「什么时候」），属于重复 sense。另外，句子多为口语（「老师，作业何时交？」「我们何时才能吃饭呢？」），与声明的书面语语域不符。

definition: 列车是一节一节连起来的长长的火车。
reviewer_notes: 重复 sense，不予修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93754 为同一义项（铁路上成列的火车），属于重复 sense。「一节一节连起来的长长的火车」并非独立义项。

definition: 朋友之间的深厚感情。
reviewer_notes: 判为 reject 的原因是义项重复，而不是句子内容有误。上列的内容问题仅作记录，只有在能证明存在真正的义项区分时才需要处理。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 93757 重复：同为“友谊”的名词、abstract 类，都带“一份友谊”量词形式，定义仅是“朋友之间的深厚感情”与 93757 的“朋友之间互相喜欢、互相帮助的好感情”的改写。词典中并无此义项区分，属于人为拆分。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “毕业以后，我们的仇恨还在。”是自然的句子，“仇恨”是可辩护的正确答案。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “两家工厂的友谊很稳定”与 93757 中的同类句一样，属于隐喻用法，不是明显错误。

definition: 大型的公共汽车。
reviewer_notes: 因重复义项而拒收，因此未给出补丁。若决定保留该义项，需按上述问题修改。A 组 level_1、level_3、level_7 及 B 组 level_6、level_7 已核对，干扰项与正确答案均无误。
reviewer_issues: document core (sense 93770): 义项与 93769 实为同一义项。两者都指载很多人的大型公共汽车，指纹差别仅在用途语境（城市路线 vs 旅游接送）。两个义项的例句在语义上可互换，学习者会得到重复练习。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0-2]: 三个错句全部是量词错误（本、张、条），不是义项判别错误，与 semantic_discrimination 练习不符。; variants.B.level_1.options[3]: 把手 bǎ shǒu 不是声调混淆的最小对立对（韵母也不同），听力题干扰项不合格。; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 解释“房间也不能坐人”不真实：大房间完全可以坐五十人。房间只因量词“辆”而被排除，解释中的语义理由是错的。

definition: 筹划；事先想办法并安排计划。
reviewer_notes: 与 93805 重复，故拒绝。其余条目未在此修复，因为整个文档不予采用。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93805 义项相同（均为“先想办法再安排/计划”）。同一义项被拆成两个 sense，两套练习会考查同一个知识点。“策划”没有第二个义项。

definition: 用舌头接触或擦过。
reviewer_notes: 与 93817 重复，故拒绝。其余条目未在此修复，因为整个文档不予采用。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 93817 义项相同（“用舌头接触或擦过”与“用舌头碰一碰”指同一义项）。“舔”只有这一个义项，两个 sense 会重复考查同一知识点。

definition: 负责维护社会治安的机关或其工作人员。
reviewer_notes: 在本义项自身的变体内容中，我逐块核查，未发现其他缺陷。驳回的理由仅是重复。句子“他向公安咨询了贷款的事。”同时出现在 93879 的 B level_6 中。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 释义“负责维护社会治安的机关或其工作人员”与 93879 的“抓坏人、保护大家平安的人，也指他们的机关”含义相同。两个义项教的是同一个意思，sense_fingerprint 也无法将二者区分。

definition: 四面围住。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate core. The sentences and option blocks are otherwise well formed, so this is a sense-inventory decision, not a content failure. If the team wants a separate person-or-object sense, it needs a different definition and different sentences, and should be reviewed as a new sense. No patches are offered because the core itself is the problem.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The sense 四面围住 / 从四周把人或物围起来 is the same meaning as 93891 (从各个方向把一个地方围住). Every sentence here is the same sense as 93891's sentences. The two senses cannot be taught separately, and the duplication makes the distractor sets collide across lessons.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: Same overbroad claim as 93891: says 着 and 了 cannot co-occur after 包围.; core.morphological_forms[0]: 包圍 is a script variant (繁体), not a morphological form.

definition: 进而是做完了一件事，接着再往下做。
reviewer_notes: 作为独立 sense 不可用，因为它与 93962 重复。这里不做修补，建议只保留 93962。
reviewer_issues: core: 本 sense 与 93962 实为同一义项：两者都描述“先……，进而……”的递进接续用法，定义措辞仅有细微差别；“进而”在词典中只有一个义项（在前一步基础上进一步）。保留两个 sense 会重复教学同一用法。

definition: 太；超过了适当的限度。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, so no patches. If the team keeps this sense instead of 93963, also check B level_6 wrong_sentences[2] (我过于谢谢你了), which is arguably acceptable, and the A level_3 distractor 极其, which fits as 93963's does.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 93963. Both describe 过于 as an adverb meaning excess ('太' / '比应该的多太多'), and the fingerprints overlap. The learner would get two identical senses.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 颇 fits “这个办法___冒险，我们不能用” grammatically and in meaning. Its register objection is weak, so it is defensibly correct.

definition: 欠别人的钱或东西，需要偿还的义务。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. For the record, the block-level defects would not change the verdict. B level_3's 银行 distractor fits 减少银行 plausibly as a policy goal, and B synonym_antonym_match's 财富 is risky for the same reason as 资产 in 93987.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 93987 (owed money or goods that must be repaid). The fingerprint and sentence set overlap heavily, so the learner would be taught one sense twice.

definition: 出身是一个人小时候的家庭，或者他以前做过什么。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a single sense, so patching would mean replacing most sentences and rebuilding every block. The block content is internally consistent. Distractors are valid and the level_6 and level_7 errors are single and clear, so the blocks can be reused when the occupational sense is regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition merges two senses: family background (工人家庭, 农村出身) and previous occupation (教师出身, 军人出身). Most sentences use the occupational reading, so single-sense pinning fails. The family-background sentences also duplicate sense 93994.

definition: 多党是有很多个党，不止一个。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项，本条目应被拒绝。应保留 94010，不要两者都保留。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 94010 为同一义项：sense_fingerprint 都是“有多个政党”，定义也几乎相同。同一词目下的重复义项会让学习者重复学习同一用法。; core.sentences[6]: “听说那个国家以前是多党，后来变成了一党”以谓语形式使用“多党”，与 94010 中“非谓形容词须带“的””的规则相矛盾。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “两国进行了多党会谈”不是明显错误，“多党会谈”本身是常见说法（指多个政党参与的会谈）。; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: “无党国家”是可以成立的说法，解释“无党不能直接修饰国家”不成立。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 句 6 中“以前是无党，后来变成了一党”是连贯的前后变化叙述，“无党”可以作为合理答案。

definition: 在短时间内容易赚到的钱。
reviewer_notes: 因与 94031 重复而拒收。上列其它问题仅在保留本义项时才需要处理。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94031 为同一义项（“短时间内容易赚到的钱”），属重复义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “银行的快钱每个月都会入账”的解释有误：利息可以按月入账。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “一个快钱”的量词边缘可接受，不是明确错误。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “花了一笔快钱”可以接受（“快钱快花”），不是明确错误。

definition: 登是一步一步向高处走上去。
reviewer_notes: 因与 94060 重复而拒收。其余句子与各块未发现明确缺陷。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94060 为同一义项（“由低处走到高处；攀登”），属重复义项。

definition: 补是把破了或少了的地方弄好，让它变完整。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, so no patches. If upstream keeps 94075 instead, fix these first: sentences[5] (口红补妆) is touch-up makeup, which drifts from the repair/completion sense; its furigana reads 掉色 as diào sè, though the standard reading is diàoshǎi (please verify). sentences[3] (补一点水) is topping up, which is borderline and overlaps 94076. The synonym_antonym decline (no_relation) is questionable, since 弄破/弄坏 can serve as the antonym in the repair sense. The active_levels list includes 2, 4 and 9, but the plan blocks do not, so the plan needs regenerating after any change.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense. 'Restore a broken or missing part to make it whole' covers the same ground as 94076 ('repair broken things or add missing parts'). Sentences 2 and 6 are 'add a missing part', which is exactly 94076's definition. Two senses teach the same meaning twice.

definition: 过道是房子里或车里，供人走过去的窄路。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94086, so no patches. If upstream keeps 94085 instead: level_1 is declined as no_minimal_pairs, which is questionable because 国道 (guó dào) is a real tone-only pair. definition: 意志是心里想把一件事做成的力量。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core, so no patches. reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates sense 94150 (为达到目的而自觉努力、克服困难的心理力量). 「心里想把一件事做成的力量」 describes the same meaning, and its sentences, sense_fingerprint and L6/L7 distractor patterns overlap heavily. definition: 兰花；多年生草本植物，花香而美。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项拒绝，无需补丁。若策展人仍保留，则 B 层6 错误句 0（“他每天喝兰”，〈茶〉）存在与 94199 相同的“兰不能喝”虚假解释，需同样修正；其余块未发现问题。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94199 指同一参照物（兰花／兰这种植物），所有例句也都指同一植物，义项无法区分，属重复义项。

definition: 角是两条线碰在一起的地方，也是牛头上长出来的硬东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core covers two senses and the sentences mix them, so a single-sense exercise cannot be built by patching. 94204 defines the same two senses, so 94203 and 94204 duplicate each other. Re-split into one corner-sense and one horn-sense document, then review again. Level_1 options (小, 巧, 减, 叫) are otherwise valid tone and initial confusions. No plan run is needed for a rejected document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss fuses two senses, corner ('两条线碰在一起的地方') and animal horn ('牛头上长出来的硬东西'), joined by 也是. The sense is not pinned.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint lists both senses (物体的角；牛羊头上的角), so disambiguation is impossible.; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[4], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[8]: Horn-sense sentences (牛头上有两个角 / 鹿的角又长又硬 / 那只羊的角弯弯的 / 小孩摸了摸牛的角) are mixed with corner-sense sentences in one document.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 隅 is a literary near-synonym of 角 in the corner sense, so it is not a clean distractor.

definition: 物体两边相交的地方；某些动物头上长的硬而尖的东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject for the same core reason as 94203. The two documents duplicate each other, so both should be replaced by one corner-sense and one horn-sense document. Level_6 A wrong sentence 他在超市买了一角牛奶 is a valid homograph distractor (currency 角) and can be kept in a re-split. No plan run is needed for a rejected document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss joins two senses, 物体两边相交的地方 and 某些动物头上长的硬而尖的东西, with ；. The sense is not pinned.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint lists both senses (物体两边相交处；动物头上的硬角).; core.sentences[2], core.sentences[6], core.sentences[8]: Horn-sense sentences (那头牛的角很大 / 山羊的角长得很长 / 这只鹿的角还没有长大) are mixed with corner-sense sentences.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 隅 is a literary near-synonym of 角 in the corner sense, so it is not a clean distractor.

definition: 证书是一张纸，上面写着你做到了某件事。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for quality. The 证书 senses overlap heavily. Keep 94208, which covers qualifications, achievements and identity and includes the issuing body. If you keep 94207 instead, apply the fixes above and reconcile the 营业证书 sentence with 94208. The level_1 block is well formed (variant A distractors 整数, 正数, 证实 are real tone-confusion words).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94208. Both gloss 证书 as an official paper certifying an achievement or qualification, and 94207's sentences fit 94208's gloss. 94208 is the broader, dictionary-accurate sense. The two senses also contradict each other: variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2] calls 营业证书 wrong here, but it fits 94208's definition (a qualification issued by a 机关).; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: 我想给朋友看我的雨伞 is grammatical and plausible (showing a new umbrella), so the distractor 雨伞 is defensibly correct in the anchor sentence.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 出国前要先办好证书 is defensible: language or study certificates are routinely needed before going abroad, so the 'wrong' sentence can be read as correct.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 忘了带证书，没法进去 can be read as acceptable where a certificate is required to enter an event or training.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他带着证书去银行存钱 is wrong, but the explanation is thin. 存单 is a deposit receipt, and a learner could reasonably read 证书 as referring to one.

definition: 因出乎意料而感到奇怪、吃惊。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94225, not for quality. If you want to keep both, give them distinct glosses; otherwise keep 94225 and carry over the sentence-level fixes listed above. The level_3 options and the level_7 corrections in both variants are otherwise correct. The B level_6 wrong sentence 我每次考前都认真复习… is also used in 94225's B level_6 list, so the same weak sentence appears in both documents.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94225. 因出乎意料而感到奇怪、吃惊 and 遇到想不到的事，吃了一惊 are the same sense, and the two sense_fingerprints overlap almost completely. Two senses with one meaning make the distractor checks unreliable, since a distractor that is correct for one can be treated as wrong for the other.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 我惊讶地决定明天去超市买菜 is marked wrong because a self-made decision cannot be a 惊讶 event. That reason is inaccurate, since 惊讶 can describe self-directed surprise (我惊讶地发现自己…). The sentence is wrong only because a planned decision is not unexpected.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 我每次考前都认真复习，考完后我惊讶地看着自己的高分 is borderline. A high score after preparing can still surprise someone, so the sentence is not clearly wrong.

definition: 副词，表示不超出某个范围，只是。
reviewer_notes: 判为reject，原因是义项重复而非内容有误：94233已覆盖相同的意义，且定义更清晰。若决定保留本义项，则需同时修正以下问题：B的level_3干扰项“一共”（与94233相同的问题）、B的level_7中的“只不外是”（语义重复），以及为避免两个义项混淆而需修改定义。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与94233（同为“不超出范围，只是”的副词用法）属于重复义项。定义开头的“副词，”也是多余的词性标注。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹与94233几乎相同，同样以词性标注开头，无法区分两个义项。

definition: 研究并撰写历史的学者。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate, not for its own content. Other defects, for the record: level_3 B distractors 小偷 and 乞丐 are weakly defensible in 这位历史家得过很大的奖 (a beggar can win a lottery prize), so that block would need replacing if the sense were kept.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 94283 ('研究和写过去发生的事的人'). Two senses teach one meaning, so this sense is redundant and not usable as a separate lesson.

definition: 最高；高到极点。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because the sense duplicates 94315. The remaining content reads clean (level_3 options, level_6 and level_7 errors), but none of it is worth keeping as a separate sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The meaning (最高、高到极点) is the same as sense 94315. 至高 has only this one sense, so the two rows would produce duplicate exercises.

definition: 副词，表示偶然、有时。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is a duplicate of 94331, not a separate learning target. Independently of the rejection, variants.A.level_3 (sentence 0) has two defensible answers: 忽然 and 猛地 both fit 大海很平静，___有海鸟飞过 (大海很平静，忽然有海鸟飞过 is natural), so the cloze is not valid as written. The sentences themselves are otherwise natural. No mined sentences. Declined blocks were not touched.
reviewer_issues: core: This sense duplicates sense 94331: same lemma, same part of speech (副词), same semantic class, same register, same meaning (偶尔/有时), and the same sentence construction. Two senses with no contrast make the answers and distractors ambiguous across senses.

definition: 叹词，打招呼或呼唤时用；也指给人或动物吃东西。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the core is mixed-sense and has the wrong pos, so it cannot be patched in place. Regenerate it as a pure 动词 sense (给人或动物吃东西) and keep the 叹词 usages in 94355. Reusable as a guide: the feed-sense material is consistent. B level_3 (sentence 6), B level_6 (correct index 9) and B level_7 ([6,7,9]) are all feed-sense; A level_1 options are valid for a wèi target; morphological_forms 喂养 and 喂食 fit this sense. The B level_6 and level_7 errors also check out.
reviewer_issues: core.pos: pos 标为叹词，但释义与多数句子所用的是动词义（给人或动物吃东西）。; core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: 释义和指纹把叹词义与动词义合并在一个文档中，违反一义项一文档。; core.sentences[0..3]: 句0–3（喂，小王…／喂，你好…／喂，别跑…／喂，我听见了…）用的是叹词义，不是本文档的义项。; variants.A.level_3 (sentence 0): 填空句用的是叹词义，并非本义项。; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index (3): “正确”句“喂，我听见了，你说吧。”是叹词用法，不是动词义，正确答案的义项不对。; variants.A.level_7.correct_sentence_indices ([0,1,2]): 列为正确的句0–2均为叹词义，不属于本义项。

definition: 工作单位是你每天去上班的地方。
reviewer_notes: 整体拒收，理由是义项本身与 94380 重复，且自身解释与锁定义项矛盾。若上游决定保留地点义，则需逐条重写 L6/L7 解释，并另行核对例句。我没有工具运行 fat_seed_runner.py plan，因此未核对 blocks 与计划是否一致。active_levels 列出了 2、4、9，但文档中没有对应 block，请由 runner 确认。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94380 实为同一义项。两者都指个人任职的单位，94379 只是把同一机构说成「每天去上班的地方」。例句如「我的工作单位离家很近」「他的工作单位在市中心」同样可以读作机构义，无法单独区分两个义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2].explanation; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..2].explanation: 解释把词义说成「所在的机构」「指机构」，与本义项自身的定义（每天上班的地方）不符。同一文档的 level_3 解释却按地点理解，前后不一致。; variants.A.level_7.error_description; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 以「不用来数机构」「不能用于机构」立论，同样把义项说成机构义。

definition: 有力量，强而有劲。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a whole because the core needs re-authoring, not patching. Other defects, for the record: A level_6 wrong sentence 这个条件对我们很有力 (有利) is borderline, since 有力 does not normally mean 有利. B level_6 correct sentence 经理有力地支持了我们的计划 uses an adverbial sense (effectively) that the definition does not cover. Once the sense is rebuilt, the L1 distractors, L7 blocks and antonym block (无力) can be reused after checking.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: '有力量，强而有劲' overlaps the physical-strength sense of 94395 ('身体或动作有很大力气'). The sense is not distinct from 94395, and it has no clean boundary.; core.sentences[1,3,6,8]: Four of ten sentences use 94395's physical sense: 手臂非常有力, 握手握得很有力, 跑起来又快又有力, 腿还很有力. The sentence set is mixed.; variants.B.level_3: The cloze (sentence 6, 那只狗跑起来又快又有力) tests the physical sense, not the locked sense.; variants.A.level_6.correct_sentence_index: The correct sentence (index 3, 他握手握得很有力) is in the physical sense, so the discrimination item tests the wrong sense.

definition: 经过一年或许多年。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as an unusable core. The sense duplicates 94415, and its pos and attributive usage conflict. Recommend merging its sentences into 94415 (the adverbial ones are already there) or reclassifying the sense if the attributive reading is kept. The variant blocks were not patched because the core would still be invalid. The level_6 wrong sentences (一会儿/整天/当天 etc.) are otherwise sound, and the level_3 distractors (冰箱/奶茶/名片) are weak but do not create a defensible-correct conflict.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-duplicate of sense 94415 (经过一年或许多年 vs 过了很多年). Same pos, register and semantic class. The only difference is usage pattern (经年之后, 经年的思念), not sense, so a learner cannot distinguish the two and the distractor logic cannot separate them.; core.pos: pos is 副词, but sentences 1 and 6 use 经年 as an attributive modifier (经年的思念, 经年的雨水). Variant level_7 corrections also rely on this (A 经年的努力, B 经年的风雨). The core POS does not describe its own sentences.; variants.B.level_7.error_description: The explanation says 经年的风雨 is correct because 经年 modifies a noun, which contradicts the 副词 pos. The corrected sentence therefore rests on a grammar claim that the sense's own POS does not support, and the item is not a clean single-error exercise.

definition: 靠近，面对；将要。
reviewer_notes: 建议：时间义（将要、快要）只保留在 94425 中；94426 应重新生成为只表示靠近或面对河、街、海的空间义，例如 临河、临街、临湖、临窗 等，并同步重建 level_6、level_7 与 synonym 模块。其余的空间义句子（0–7）本身没有问题，可以在重建时复用。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义和指纹都把“将要”（时间义）并入“靠近、面对”（空间义）之中，但这是 94425 的义项。文档 core 中的句子 8（临下雨前，天气特别闷）和句子 9（临睡前，她喜欢听音乐）都属于时间义，违反“每句都用定义所描述的义项”的要求。B 变体的 level_6 正确句（index 9）、level_7 正确句（index 9）和 synonym 句（index 9）都依赖这一句子，A 的 level_6 错句中也有 临下雨之后、临三岁 这类时间用法。

definition: 机关、学校、团体等统一规定式样的服装。
reviewer_notes: 核心内容不可用，因为它与 94467 重复，故驳回。其他块仅作记录，不作为修改依据。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94467 的义项重复：二者定义、指纹和例句的核心含义相同（统一规定式样的服装）。; variants.B.level_1: 同样以 no_minimal_pairs 放弃，但同一词头的最小对立对（致富、字符）存在，理由不成立。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这次去爬山，他特意穿了一身制服。”：与 94467 中的问题相同，可解读为统一购置的登山服，属于边界句。

definition: 名字叫作。

Its level_3 and level_7 blocks are otherwise sound, so the content is salvageable by merging. Level_1 is declined, which is final. The active_levels mismatch also applies. Not verified by running the plan command.
reviewer_issues: sense as a whole: 与 94473 为同一义项（名字叫作），属重复义项，不应作为独立义项教授。; sentences 2, 5, 7, 8 (sense fingerprint contradiction): fingerprint 声明用于地方、事物、书名，但句子 2（客人马丁）、5（同学林林）、7（哥哥的朋友高山）、8（电影里的小男孩小东）均指人，与自身 fingerprint 矛盾。; core.definition: 释义“名字叫作。”过于简略，缺少主语和用法说明，与 fingerprint 不一致。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2] and variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他名叫医生”与“这种花名叫红色”均可被读作合理的（戏谑）名字，错误性存疑。

definition: 封建是很久以前，国王把地分给别人管的那种制度。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项不可用，因为它与 94494 重复，故驳回。其余内容（例如 level_7 的量词错误“只”改“种”）解释正确，但不影响驳回结论。synonym_antonym_match 的放弃理由（no_relation）在计划中允许，但若保留该义项，应考虑郡县对立。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94494 的义项重复：“国王把地分给别人管的那种制度”与“古代君主把土地分给贵族管理的社会制度”含义相同，指纹也几乎一致。; core.sentences[2]: “老师给我们讲了封建的历史。”及“这部电影讲的是封建年代的事。”中，“封建”作定语修饰名词，接近形容词用法，与标注的名词义项不一致。

definition: 才能和天赋。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的依据是义项重复，而不是句子质量；这些句子本身基本干净。若流程要保留两个义项，两者的定义必须体现真正的区别，而这些句子并未显示这种区别。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94507 义项重复。两者都是“天生的才能/天赋”（“天生就会做某些事的本事” 与 “才能和天赋”），本义项的每个句子也都同样符合 94507 的定义。同一释义出现两个义项，会给学习者两个相同的义项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2].explanation: “种……不用于植物”的说法不真确：“种”可用于植物（如“一种花”）。真正的错因是“株”专用于植物。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这个孩子才分让大家很佩服。”省略“的”，属于类似“孩子脾气”的名词修饰，口语中可接受，因此错误不成立。

definition: 政治运动是很多人为了国家的某种想法一起做的大行动。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant sense. No patches are offered, since no sentence edit would make it a distinct sense. Its sentences are individually fine for the shared meaning. If the reject is overruled, these defects must be fixed: (a) B level_3 distractor 生日 is defensible in 书里写了一场很大的___ (a big birthday party is 一场很大的生日). (b) A level_6 wrong sentence 妈妈做了一场政治运动 is weak. 做一场 for a mass movement is not clearly wrong, so swap it for a sentence with a clear category error. (c) B level_6 wrong sentence 桌上
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. 94515 (“许多人为了国家的某种想法一起参加的大行动”) and 94516 (“为实现某种政治目标而发动的大规模群众活动”) describe the same meaning. A learner cannot tell which sense a given sentence uses, so the lock-in (义项匹配) test cannot pass for either.

reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate of sense 94523. Its definition 介于东和南之间的方向 and sense_fingerprint 东和南之间的方向 describe the same direction sense as 94523 (东边和南边中间的方向). definition: 档案；等级、类别；变速的位置。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝理由：核心的词形与读音对该义项不成立，无法通过补丁修正，需以「挡 dǎng」为词形重新撰写。这一判断较有把握，但建议编辑人员核实标准书写形式。句子本身（A 与 B 两组的正确句、错误句与修正句）在变速义项下均通顺，计划与文档索引一致。
reviewer_issues: core.pronunciation, variants.A.level_1.options[0] (档 dàng) and options[2] (挡 dǎng): 变速挡位的标准读音是 guà dǎng（挂挡、换挡），标准书写为「挡」。本文档将该义项标为「档 dàng」，所以 L1 的正确答案与该义项的标准读音不符；而「挡」作为干扰项的解释「意思是阻挡」对该义项也是错误的。; core.definition: 定义「档案；等级、类别；变速的位置」列出三个义项，违反单义项要求。

definition: 国王的儿子。

If the pipeline keeps this sense instead of 94539, the issues above need fixing.

definition: 众人是很多人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 94560, not for item defects alone. Keep 94560. If a human decides to keep 94559 instead, the minimum changes are: replace A level_3 option 诸君, replace B level_3 option 众生, remove A level_6 wrong sentence 请众人保持安静, and replace the A level_7 incorrect sentence with a clearer error.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “众人是很多人” is circular and nearly identical to 94560 (“大家；许多人”). The added “在场” in the fingerprint is not a separate dictionary meaning, so the two senses cannot be taught apart.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “请众人保持安静，不要大声说话。” is a correct use under 94560 (大家), so it is not a clean wrong sentence.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “诸君” fits the blank grammatically and in meaning, and 书面语 is the declared register, so it is defensibly correct. The explanation relies on register alone.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “众生” (all living beings) fits “大雨来了，众生急忙躲进了小店” grammatically and in meaning, and 书面语 matches the declared register. Defensibly correct.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “众人们” is a redundancy (赘余) error, not a grammatical one, and it is widely used. It is weak as the single clear error.

definition: 砸是用重的东西用力打下去，把东西打坏。
reviewer_notes: This is a core-level duplication, so no patch is offered. Sentence, distractor and explanation checks found no further defect beyond the overlap. B level_6 "他一脚砸坏了门" has the same weakness as 94562's foot sentence, so fix it if this sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core: The definition (用重的东西用力打下去，把东西打坏) describes the same action as sense 94562 (用重物撞击使破碎): a heavy object strikes and damages. The sentences are interchangeable across the two senses, e.g. 把门砸坏了 / 砸坏了门锁 / 砸坏了邻居的车 could all be 94562 sentences. The sense cannot be pinned, so exercises built on it cannot be defended.

definition: 旧时对皇帝的称呼；欢呼时用来表示祝愿的口号。
reviewer_notes: Reject: the definition merges two senses, and sentences 1, 3, 6 and 9 use the cheer sense that belongs to 94571. Regenerate the sense from fingerprint 旧时称呼皇帝的说法, with a definition limited to the title use and sentences free of 高喊/大喊/欢呼 contexts. Then regenerate the blocks, since B level_3 (sentence 6), B level_6 (correct 9) and B level_7 (6, 7, 9) depend on drifted sentences. The plan was not regenerated (no tools). active_levels includes 4 and 9, but morphological_forms is empty and neither level has a block.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义同时含两个义项：「旧时对皇帝的称呼」和「欢呼时用来表示祝愿的口号」。后者即 94571 的义项，违反义项锁定，与 sense_fingerprint「旧时称呼皇帝的说法」不一致。; core.sentences[1]: 「大臣们跪在地上，高喊“皇帝万岁”。」中的万岁是欢呼口号义，属于 94571 的义项，不是称呼义。; core.sentences[9]: 「皇帝走过来，所有人都大声喊：“万岁！”」是欢呼义。它是 B level_6 的正确句，会让该题与 94571 混淆。; core.sentences[6]: 「皇帝一出来，大家就跪下高喊万岁。」是欢呼义。B level_3 的 cloze 与 B level_7 的正确句都依赖该句，其中 B level_3 的干扰项（圣旨、礼物、奏章）和解释也都建立在「高喊」语境上。; core.sentences[3]: 「古时候，百姓见了皇帝，要喊万岁。」语义模糊，「喊万岁」更接近欢呼。A level_6 的正确句依赖该句。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 「旧时候，人们称呼皇帝是万岁。」中「称呼X是Y」结构语法上可接受，母语者未必判为错误，标注的「为/是」错误不成立。; variants.A.level_3.options[3].explanation: 解释称「太监」口语色彩强，说法不准确。「太监」是旧时宦官的通行称呼，并非口语。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「宫女见到皇帝，轻声说：“万岁。”」中的低声问候在宫廷语境下未必不可接受，错误理由不够稳固。

definition: 枪械发射的、前端尖的弹丸。
reviewer_notes: 义项本身无法独立成立，因为它与 94613 的概念完全重复，应当合并。若需要保留其句子，可以并入 94613。A 的 level_3 干扰项“铅笔”在语义上可以成立，只是量词“颗”不对（应为“支”）。这一点属于临界情况，但考虑到锚句的量词已经限制了答案，可以保留。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 94613 指向同一概念（子弹），是重复的义项。另外，“前端尖”并非所有子弹的特征，平头弹等就不是尖的，因此释义也偏窄、不够准确。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 干扰项“月亮”在锚句中并非明显错误：弯月的两端确实是尖的，所以“这颗月亮的前端是尖的”可以被母语者接受。解释“月亮是圆的，没有尖的前端”对弯月并不成立。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “那只子弹”的错误不够干净，理由与 94613 相同：“只”并非完全不能用，解释的绝对说法不成立。

definition: 常委是一个大团体里，常常要做决定的几个人。
reviewer_notes: Core duplication cannot be fixed by editing sentences. Also, the level_6 A wrong sentence '这个学会有三只常委' is a classifier error, not a semantic one, and it duplicates the level_7 A error. The level_6 items are meant to test meaning.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 94626. Both describe the same standing-committee member, and every sentence here (0-9) fits 94626 equally well. The two senses would produce identical exercises with conflicting sense labels.

definition: 存心，故意；也指心里有某种打算或愿望。

reviewer_issues: core.definition: “存心，故意”与 94649 的义项（想好了才去做，即故意）完全相同。同一字形下两个义项意思重叠，学习者无法区分。; core.sentences[0]: “他有意躲着我，不想见面”是故意义，属于 94649 的义项而非本义项。; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: “竞争合作”是通行说法（竞合），“两家公司竞争合作”在语境中可以接受，所以“竞争”不是可靠的错误项。说明“不能说竞争合作”也不属实。; variants.A.level_6: 错误句的判断依据全部是故意义，与本义项（打算、愿望）不符，level_6 测不到本义项。

definition: 因受热或受压而突然破裂并发出巨响；也指突然发生。
reviewer_notes: The core is not a single sense, so patching cannot fix it. Plan blocks match the document; active_levels lists 4 with no level_4 block, which should be re-checked after regeneration.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合在一起：“因受热或受压而突然破裂并发出巨响”与 94669 的“东西突然裂开并发出响声”几乎相同，另一半“也指突然发生”是独立义项。sense_fingerprint 同样混合了两者。; core.sentences[0,1,6,8,9]: 这五个例句（水管、盖子、车胎、饮料瓶、手机）描写的是东西受热或受压突然裂开并发声，与 94669 的义项重叠。学习者无法判断哪个义项适用，例如“夏天太热，车胎爆了”几乎就是 94669 的“车胎爆了”。; core.sentences[2,3,4,5,7]: 只有这五个例句（新闻、冷门、欢呼、脏话、笑声）属于“突然发生／出现”义，但它们与其余五句共处于同一义项，且 level 区块依赖的 index 0 和 9 属于重叠义。

definition: 指现在这个时候，或上文所说的那个时刻。

Also note: A level_7 incorrect sentence 市政府为优秀教师颁发了的一枚奖章 is arguable (了的 before a numeral phrase is marginal), so recheck it when the sense is rebuilt. A and B are otherwise distinct.

A document must describe one sense.; core.sentences[0]: Award-sense sentences (0, 3, 6, 9) duplicate 94745. definition: 来的道路；也指事物的来源。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core merges two senses, and half of its sentences duplicate 94759. Source-only sentences 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 are sound and can seed a rebuilt source-only sense; the road sentences should be removed. No source field is present, so provenance cannot be checked.

Sentences 0, 1, 2, 6 and 8 use the road reading; 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 use the source reading. This breaks the one-sense rule and duplicates 94759.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “我们选了一条最近的来路回家”is defensibly acceptable under this sense's own road reading (the nearest of the roads we came by). It is not a valid wrong sentence.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “通过这个来路，我们可以学会英语”can pass as “through this source”, and the definition includes 事物的来源. definition: 公式是算数时用的固定办法。

reviewer_issues: variants.A.level_1.options[2]: 公司 is described as differing only in tone, but sī differs from shì in both initial and tone. The level_6 wrong sentences in bo
