definition: 毕业生是读完学校所有的课、要离开的学生。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 95102. The rest of this document is not used. The level_1 decline is reasonable. The level_7 B error (漏掉「的」) is a real error but tests a grammar point, not the sense. Plan for this sense has no synonym_antonym block, which is consistent with the plan as written.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Definition 读完学校所有的课、要离开的学生 means students about to leave. Its own sentences use the alumni sense: 1 (这位毕业生正在找工作) and 9 (他是我们学校最好的毕业生). The definition does not match the sentences.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 毕业生们正在学校门口报到 is arguably acceptable, because graduates do 报到 (e.g. to an employer). It is not clearly wrong, so it is an unsafe distractor.; sense_id 95101 vs 95102: Two sense entries carry the same meaning: a student who has graduated. The distinction between 'about to leave' and 'has graduated' is not a real dictionary sense split here.

definition: 一国货币兑换另一国货币的比率。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on duplication alone. Its own blocks mostly hold up (the level_3, level_6 and level_7 items are sound), but the B level_1 decline has the same defect as 95155, so that would need the same fix if this sense were kept.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 95155. Both are 名词 with the same gloss (one currency's exchange ratio against another's), the same fingerprint in substance, and the same usage in every block. Two senses that teach the same meaning produce redundant items with the same answers.

definition: 用嘴巴发出好听的声音，一句一句唱出歌来。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95198 重复，故整体拒收，无需补丁。其余区块也有同样的过度概括（如“唱”只用于歌曲），在拒收前不予修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95198「发声演唱歌曲」指同一个义项（都是用声音演唱歌曲），同一词义被拆成两个 sense_id，属于重复义项。

definition: 对人或事物极为敬佩、爱慕。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the sense duplicates 95217 (see the first issue). Issues are listed in case the pipeline overrides the verdict. Do not generate a plan for 95218. If it is kept anyway, all issues above must be fixed first.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 95217. Both define 崇拜 as admiring or revering a person (非常喜欢一个人，觉得他特别了不起 versus 极为敬佩、爱慕). 95218 adds 某事物, but none of its ten sentences uses a non-person object, and every sentence fits 95217 equally well. A learner cannot tell the two entries apart, so one of them is redundant.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「村民每年都崇拜山神。」 is a correct use of 崇拜 in the religious sense 敬奉神灵, which the explanation itself acknowledges. It is defensibly correct and cannot serve as a wrong option.; variants.A.level_1.options: The distractors 重排, 重拍 and 葱白 differ from 崇拜 in two features each, so they fail the listening-distractor rule. This is the same defect as in 95217.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 「我很崇拜他的眼神。」 can be read as admiring someone's charisma or gaze. That reading is borderline acceptable, so the sentence is weak as a wrong option.

definition: 跟随师父学习的人；学生。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core duplicates 95225, not because the blocks are individually broken. Merge instead of shipping separately. If the sense were kept, the B level_6 defects and pronunciation would need fixing. Declined B level_1 is final and not reported.
reviewer_issues: core (whole sense): Duplicates 95225. Both define 弟子 as a person who learns a skill from a master. 95226 differs only in domain examples (martial arts, religion), and its level_1 block is copied from 95225. This is not a real dictionary sense split.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: The sentence 我的电脑里存了很多文件，都是照片。 does not contain the target 弟子, so it is not a wrong use of the word. Its explanation (〈文件〉) only makes sense with the target in the blank.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: The sentence 书架上摆着很多书，都是新买的。 does not contain 弟子. Same defect as above.; core.pronunciation and core.ipa: Same non-standard dì zǐ reading as 95225.

definition: 因做错事或给人添麻烦而心中不安，表示歉意。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the core is rejected as a duplicate. If it were retained instead, fix: variants.A.level_3 distractor 惶恐 is rejected only on register, but 惶恐 can mean apologetic in formal letters, so it is not clearly wrong; replace it. Other content checks: variants.A.level_7 很的抱歉 is a clear error, and variants.B.level_7 抱歉的看着我 is a clear 地/的 error. The level_6 wrong sentences are clean. Plan matches the document.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicates sense 95233. Both define 抱歉 as the unease and apology for having done wrong or caused trouble. Sentence 8 is a regret use, which is not what the definition says.

definition: 把零散的部分合在一起，也指尽力去做。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable as a single sense, so regenerate instead of patching. The B side is mostly sound: the B level_7 error 拼的很努力 (的/得) involves the target, and the B level_3 and level_6 options are clean. The synonym_antonym_match declines (no_relation) are allowed by the plan.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: The definition merges two senses: 把零散的部分合在一起 (identical to 95235) and 尽力去做. The fingerprint merges them too. This breaks the one-sense-per-sense-ID rule.; core.sentences[0], core.sentences[1], core.sentences[5], core.sentences[8]: These four sentences use the assembly sense (拼在一起 / 拼起来 / 拼成), which duplicates 95235 and drifts from this sense's effort meaning.; variants.A.level_3: The cloze sentence the plan assigns (sentence 0, 他把零件一个一个拼在一起) is an assembly-sense sentence, and the option set is built around it. The document does not carry the sentence, so this cannot be fixed by patching options.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: The error (拼了一个年 → 拼了一年) is a measure-word error on 年. It does not involve the target word's usage, so it fails the level_7 rule.

definition: 把东西一样一样写下来的纸。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 95250. Merge rather than ship separately. The shopping-list example sentences are good and should be kept in 95250. Declined A and B level_1 are final and not reported.
reviewer_issues: core (whole sense): Subsumed by 95250. A shopping list is one case of 'an itemized list of things or matters'. Defining 清单 as a paper for shopping, separate from the general list, is not a real dictionary sense split. The overlap is visible in the level_6 distractors, which are correct under 95250.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 这位音乐家写了一份清单，记录下他的交响曲。 describes a works list (作品清单), which is a legitimate use of 清单 in the general sense. The wrongness depends only on the narrow definition.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: 他翻开清单，读着里面的一首诗。 describes an itemized list of poems, which fits the general sense of 清单. Not clearly wrong.; variants.B.level_3.options[2]: 乐谱 is grammatical in 爸爸拿着乐谱走进超市. It is excluded only by pragmatic oddness, which makes it a weak distractor.

definition: 当事人不服判决，请求上级法院重新审理。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 95305 (both are 'appeal to a higher court after disagreeing with a judgment'). Keep 95305 and drop this one. The issues above are recorded for the record and do not need patching if the sense is dropped. The L1 no_minimal_pairs decline has the same 上述 problem as 95305.
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_7.error_description: The explanation is false. 可以 plus a verb can take 着 (e.g. 可以坐着), so the stated rule is wrong. The real reason is that 上诉 is a one-time action.; variants.A.level_3.options[1]: 汇报 is grammatical in 他对判决不服，向上级法院汇报 and can be read as reporting dissatisfaction, so it is a defensible alternative.

definition: 人住的地方。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of sense 95318 (人住的地方 vs 居住的地方, same meaning). Keep 95318. The variants are otherwise sound: the L6 and L7 classifier errors are valid and the L3 distractors are clearly wrong.
reviewer_issues: variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: 他住地离公司不远 is an arguable error. Pronoun-plus-noun without 的 is not always ungrammatical, so the error is weak.

definition: 描述数据属性与来源的数据，即元数据。
reviewer_notes: 仅因重复而拒绝，本义项的例句与变体内容本身基本合格。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95321 义项相同（描述数据属性与来源的资料即元数据，与说明资料的资料为同一义），同一义项被切成两个 sense_id，学习者会在两处看到同义内容，变体干扰项也无法区分。

definition: 离开本国到外国去。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as redundant with 95331, not for content errors. Its other blocks (level 6, level 7, antonym) were otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 95331 ('离开自己的国家，到别的国家去' vs '离开本国到外国去'). Two senses for one meaning means the sentences and blocks teach the same thing twice.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 出访 ('出国访问') is a near-synonym of 出国 and implies an official visit. Its only clash with 旅游 is register, so a learner could defensibly pick it in 「我打算明年夏天出访旅游」.

definition: 一个国家里最高的一位领导人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected: duplicate sense plus an inaccurate defining gloss. Other blocks were checked and their distractors do not fit, but the core cannot be kept as written. Retain 95356.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of 95356, which covers the same head-of-state sense of 国家主席.; core.definition: The gloss '一个国家里最高的一位领导人' is inaccurate for 国家主席 in the Chinese context. The office is head of state, and top leadership sits with 中共中央总书记.; core.sentences[0].text: '国家主席是一个国家最高的领导人。' repeats the inaccurate claim, and it is the level 3 cloze sentence.

definition: 女孩长大后，去和一个男人结婚，住到他家里。
reviewer_notes: 拒收：与 95370 重复。建议保留 95370，并把本文档中可用的句子并入其中。其余项目（L1、L3、L6 B、L7 A）单独看基本合格，但在合并时需要修正 L7 B 的错因解释。
reviewer_issues: core.definition, core.sense_fingerprint: 与 95370 是同一个义项（女子出嫁、结为夫妻）。“住到他家里”不足以让学习者区分两个义项。两版的句子、反义词（娶）和错句都可以互换，属于重复的义项。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “他把桃枝嫁到了李树上”用的是“嫁”的嫁接义（嫁接义在词典中存在），并非错句，只是另一义项。; variants.B.level_7.error_description: 解释有误：“嫁”可以用于“把”字句（如“把女儿嫁到邻县”）。此句真正的错误是“把”后缺少宾语，而不是“嫁”不能用“把”字句。

definition: 一个地方给人的感觉，比如热闹或安静。
reviewer_notes: Blocks checked and sound: level_3 distractors (人口/价格/包裹; 货架/价格/行李) do not fit the blank, level_6 and level_7 errors are single and correct, explanations are true. Rejection is for the duplicate only. If the team would rather keep this document, retire 95404 instead. Declined blocks not reviewed.
reviewer_issues: core: Duplicate sense. Its definition and fingerprint (a place's feel or atmosphere) match 95404 almost exactly, and its examples are the same kind of sentence. Two identical-sense ladders teach nothing new and make distractors ambiguous across senses.

definition: 软软甜甜的点心，过生日时常吃。
reviewer_notes: 作为重复义项退役。若所有者决定同时保留两个“蛋糕”义项，则两者必须合并或重新界定，不能并存。其余问题仅供记录。
reviewer_issues: core.sense_fingerprint: 与 95432 为同一词义（松软烤制甜点）。“过生日时吃”是用法语境，不是独立义项。“这个蛋糕软软的”“这块蛋糕又软又甜”等句子两个义项都能套用，学习者会重复学同一义。; variants.A.level_7: 错误是补语“得”缺失（“切很整齐”），不涉及目标词“蛋糕”的用法，偏离 level_7 对目标词的要求。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “硬邦邦”的陈旧蛋糕并非绝对不合法，判错理由不够干净，母语者可能接受。

definition: 死亡，多用于意外事故。
reviewer_notes: 作为 95445 的重复义项退役。若所有者决定需要单独的“意外死亡”义项，则必须给出区别于 95445 的释义，并重新检查其句子。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “多用于意外事故”是语境倾向，不构成独立义项。与 95445 同为“人死亡”，句子（如“不幸身亡”“当场身亡”）两义都能套用。

definition: 对令人尊敬的人去世的敬称。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not an unusable one: the sense duplicates 95449, and the duplicated distractors show the same spurious split. The individual blocks are mostly sound (for example, 出版 and 发表 fail as intransitive predicates), but nothing here adds a learnable distinction. If the product wants both lemmas, the senses need different definitions first, which would be a new sense design task rather than a patch.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “对令人尊敬的人去世的敬称”与 95449 的“对很受人尊敬的人去世的说法”实质相同，不构成独立义项。; variants.A.level_1 / variants.B.level_1 / synonym_antonym_match options: A level_1 与 95449 B level_1 的选项完全相同，B level_1 与 95449 A level_1 相同；两个 synonym_antonym_match 的选项也与 95449 完全相同。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这棵老树前年逝世，树叶都落光了。”与 95449 B level_6 的第一个错句完全相同。

definition: 管一本书或一份报纸怎样出来的那个人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected only because the sense is redundant with 95476; the core is not otherwise broken. Its sentences are fine for 95476, so they can be reused there if the merge is chosen. Its variant blocks were not patched because the sense is rejected.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95476. Both define the chief editor of a book, newspaper or magazine. Their fingerprints and example sentences overlap almost entirely (for example, 这家报纸的主编换人了 and 作者给主编写了一封信 fit either). A learner cannot pin one sense to a sentence.

definition: 高级军官；率领军队的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not for a content error. The option blocks are sound on their own: A level_3 distractors are not defensible in sentence 0, A level_6 has 3 wrong plus 1 correct, A level_7 error is the classifier 只 with 人, B level_7 error is the redundant 们 after 这三位, and the plan's indices match the document. If the editor would rather keep 95528 and drop 95527, swap the two rejections.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as 95527 (带兵打仗的军官). The fingerprint 地位较高、指挥军队 adds no distinction a learner could test, and the sentences use the word the same way 95527 does.

definition: 创建某事物的人。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, not for a content error. The option blocks are sound on their own: A level_6 wrong sentences (作者, 导演, 量词 座) are wrong for the stated reasons, B level_6 has 3 wrong plus 1 correct, B level_7 error is 只 with 人, and the plan's indices match the document. If the editor would rather keep 95540 and drop 95539, swap the two rejections.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 95539 (把一个东西做起来的人, fingerprint 把店、学校、网站等做起来的人). Its own sentences include school, company and organization founders, which 95539 already covers.

definition: 事先筹划和准备。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core. Its option blocks show no defect that a patch would fix, but the sense has no separate meaning to teach. Also, core sentence index 6 carries an extra 'furigana' key that is not in the schema.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 95597 (same headword, same meaning: 事先筹划/准备 vs 事先把要用的东西准备好). Every sentence here also fits 95597's gloss, so the sense cannot be pinned or taught as distinct.

definition: 路途之中。
reviewer_notes: The sentences and blocks are internally sound (the distractors are clearly wrong and the level_6 and level_7 items are valid), so the only reason to reject is the duplicate sense. The core is not usable as a distinct sense, so nothing is patched. The curator should merge or drop it.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 95627. 路途之中 and 在路上，还没有到目的地 describe the same situation, and the two fingerprints overlap completely. The same meaning would be taught twice under two ids.

definition: 年纪较小的女性；女孩。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95677 重复，不能作为独立的教学义项，因此判退。其余练习（level_3 的正确答案“女孩子”、level_6 与 level_7 的序号）与 plan 一致，干扰项也基本成立，但这些都改变不了义项重复的问题。level_6 的错误句同样只测量词。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “年纪较小的女性；女孩”与 95677 的“年纪小的女生”实为同一义项，被拆成两个重复的感义。句 7“没有女孩子”取“女儿”义，其余句子则是泛指女孩，义项边界混杂，无法形成清楚的单一义项。; core.sentences[4]: “我想要一个女孩子，叫她小美”生硬，“想要一个女孩子”的说法不自然。

definition: 经过比较后选择某一方面，表示情愿。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a redundant core, so no patches were written. Reviewing it anyway surfaced further problems that would need fixing if it were kept as a distinct sense. Its A level_6 wrong sentence 「我宁愿跑步，也要跑步」 has the same 〈干脆〉 explanation problem as 95683. Its B level_6 wrong sentences are identical to 95683 B, including the 「天下雨」 sentence, which is defensibly acceptable. The sentence 「我宁愿现在难一点，以后就轻松了」 is unnatural. Keep 95683 as the single 宁愿 sense unless a real second sense can be defined.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: This sense duplicates 95683. Both have the same POS and register and the same meaning (prefer one option, with the cost accepted). The difference between 也要 and 也不 is a construction difference, not a sense difference. Learners would meet two items with the same answer, and the fingerprint does not separate them.

definition: 几乎；险些。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因为它只是 95691 的重复。无需逐块修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95691 完全重复：二者都表示“险些发生但未发生”，sense_fingerprint 只是换了措辞，level_1 选项也完全相同。两个义项无法在教学中区分，学习者会得到相互矛盾或冗余的练习。

definition: 火灾是东西着了大火。大火会烧坏房子，也会让人受伤。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95724 重复，不能单独成立，故 reject，不给补丁。若因故必须保留此条，则 variants.A.level_6 的错误句“消防员冲进火灾，把老人背了出来”只依赖“冲进火灾”的转喻用法，属于临界，需要替换。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95724 为同一义项（均指火失控而烧毁财物、伤害人的灾害事故），sense_fingerprint 也只是措辞不同。同一义项拆成两条会重复教学，并使消歧失去意义。

definition: 某事物所独有的，别的事物不具备的。
reviewer_notes: 核心义项与 95731 重复，故 reject，不给补丁。若此条因故保留，则 variants.A.level_6 的三个错误句（写作风格、装修、设计）都只是“很特有”一种错误，学习者只会学到一个窄规则，应换成不同类型的错误。其余 blocks 核对无误。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “某事物所独有的，别的事物不具备的”与 95731 的“只有这一个才有，别的都没有”同义；fingerprint 仅在例子领域上不同（风味 / 文化 vs 动植物）。同一义项重复教学。

definition: 省份是一个国家里分出来的大块地方。每个省份都有自己的名字。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95736, which should be kept. Also weak in this sense: B level_6's three wrong sentences (每一条 / 每一块 / 每一片省份) fail only on the measure word, so the item tests classifiers, not the sense. A level_6 wrong sentence 3 (我家在一只靠海的省份) is the same kind of measure-word error. The A level_3 distractor 鸡蛋 is weak but not clearly wrong.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates 95736 (both mean the province-level administrative region). The sense_fingerprints are nearly identical. Two ladders would test the same meaning with the same kinds of sentences and distractors.; variants.A.level_1.options[3].explanation: 生分 is pronounced shēng fèn, not fēn. The only difference from 省份 is the tone of the first syllable, so the stated reason is false.

definition: 穿在腰部以下、遮盖双腿的衣服。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense is redundant, not because its content is wrong. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, it needs the same level_1 fix as 95761 (its A level_1 options are the old 95761 B set, and its B level_1 options are the old 95761 A set, both with the same weak items).
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 95761 (trousers worn on the legs). It is a duplicate sense, not a distinct one. Its level_1 option sets are also the 95761 sets with A and B swapped.

definition: 指网站、软件、系统等开始运行或对外使用；也指登录网络。
reviewer_notes: Reject for sense pinning and duplication, not for block quality. I checked every A and B block: each has exactly one correct option, distractors are not defensibly correct, and explanations are true. A.level_1 上香 has the same weak-confusable issue as 95789. Sentences 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 9 are launch-sense and usable if the launch meaning is kept in 95789 only. Plan indices match the document. Core sentences untouched.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition and fingerprint bundle two senses: 开始运行或对外使用 (launch) and 登录网络 (log in). The launch part duplicates sense 95789, so the entry is not pinned to one sense.; core.sentences[4]: Sentences 4 (他每天晚上八点准时上线和朋友聊天), 5 (你上线的时候，请给我发一条消息) and 8 (他的账号昨天晚上没有上线过) use the log-in sense, while sentences 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 9 use the launch sense. The sentence set therefore violates one-sense pinning.

definition: 使用或办事方便，不费事。
reviewer_notes: Not patched because the sense is redundant. If the pipeline keeps it anyway, B level_7 has the same problem as 95801: “手续比便利多了” has a recoverable comparand, so the claim that it is ungrammatical is weak and it needs the same kind of replacement. Its A level_1 options duplicate the 95801 A set. The synonym_antonym_match options are sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same meaning as sense 95801 (convenient / easy to do). It is a duplicate sense.

definition: 平方公里是量一块地有多大的单位。
reviewer_notes: 核心不可用，因为它与 95850 重复。无需逐块修补。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 95850 重复：二者都是“平方公里”这一面积单位，区分不成立。本义项的释义“量一块地有多大的单位”限定为土地，但其例句包括国家、山、草原等，且释义本身循环（“平方公里是…的单位”）。

definition: 没有关联；不相干。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject 的理由是与 95875 重复，而不是核心不可用。若决定两者都保留，须同时修正 B.level_1.options[2] 与 B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]。其余 block 检查通过：A 层 level_3、level_6、level_7 与 synonym_antonym_match 的正确选项唯一，错句均确有错误。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 95875 为同一义项（与某事没有关系，即“与…无干”），释义仅措辞不同，同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id，学习者会在同一层级重复学到同一义项。; variants.B.level_1.options[2]: 与 95875 相同：语感（yǔ gǎn）与 wú gān 韵母与两个声调均不同，不是合格的听感混淆项。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 与 95875 相同：解释断言“无干不能与紧要连用”，但“无干紧要”可视为“无关紧要”的变体，错句不确定。

definition: 真实的人，区别于图画、模型、玩偶等。
reviewer_notes: 判 reject 的理由是与 95885 重复，而不是核心不可用。若决定两者都保留，须修正 B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]。其余检查通过：A 层 level_3 的正确选项唯一（比真人还高），level_6 与 level_7 的错句均确有错误（量词误用、与“只”相关的动物量词误用）。
reviewer_issues: core: 与 95885 为同一义项（真实的人，相对于图画、假物或模型），释义与例句模式高度重叠，同一义项被拆成两个 sense_id。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “真人”在口语中可指真诚直率的人，“他是个真人，说话从不绕弯子”未必确定错误；解释“不表示为人诚实”过于绝对。

definition: 访谈是一个人去问另一个人问题，听他讲。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95922. The sense is redundant, not unusable as a gloss. The document has no source fields, so no mined-sentence constraint applies. active_levels includes 2, 4 and 9 but the document has no blocks for them. Plan re-run needed only if this sense survives.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Near-duplicate of sense 95922. '去问别人问题并听对方讲' and '面对面交谈以了解情况听取意见' describe the same meaning, and no sentence here shows a distinct sense.; core.morphological_forms[2]: '访谈录' is a derived noun, not an inflected form of the verb 访谈.; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: '上个月访谈着几位退休教师' is a durative past reading and can be grammatical. The stated reason (着 conflicts with a completed past time) is misleading, so the sentence does not reliably fail for the annotated reason.; core.sentences[7]: '我们先访谈，再写报告' uses 访谈 with no object and reads weakly.

definition: 转载是把别人写的文章拿来，放到另一个地方登出来。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95926. The sense is redundant, not unusable as a gloss. No source fields are present, so no mined-sentence constraint applies. active_levels includes 2, 4 and 9 but the document has no blocks for them.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate of sense 95926. '把别人写的文章拿来，放到另一个地方登出来' and '把已经发表过的文章从一处刊载到另一处' are the same sense. The 95926 gloss is more precise.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: '作者在论文里转载了一段话' is borderline: 转载 of a passage is used in online contexts, so the sentence may be acceptable.; core.sentences[3]: Only this sentence carries an extra 'furigana' key; no other sentence in the document has it.

definition: 通向某地。
reviewer_notes: Blocks individually look fine, but the core is redundant. The judge should not accept two senses that describe the same meaning. The A level_1 options are copied verbatim from 95929, which is consistent with the duplicate.
reviewer_issues: sense 95930 as a whole: Duplicate sense. '通向某地' with fingerprint '道路、桥梁等通向某个地方' is the same sense as 95929 ('路可以走到某个地方'). The usage in the sentences is also identical, so the learner would see one sense taught twice.

definition: 顶级是最好最好，排在最上面。
reviewer_notes: The A level_7 explanation ('双音节形容词不能重叠') is also a false general rule, since many two-syllable adjectives reduplicate (漂亮 to 漂漂亮亮). The B level_1 decline is weak because A found minimal pairs (定级, 等级, 丙级, 丁级) for the same word and pronunciation. Level_3 and level_6 blocks are otherwise clean.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Garbled definition: '顶级是最好最好，排在最上面。' has a doubled '最好最好' and is not a usable gloss.; sense 95937 as a whole: Duplicate sense. 95937 ('最好的，排在最上面的') and 95938 ('级别最高的，最上等的') describe the same adjectival sense of 顶级 with the same example types.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: Declined with no_relation, but 低级 is a direct antonym of 顶级 in its 'top grade' sense. The decline is not justified.

definition: 束头发或装饰头发的带子。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate of 95943; no patches, since the core is unusable as a separate sense. The sentences are otherwise clean (level_3 distractors are clearly wrong, level_6 and level_7 errors are valid), so the content can be reused under 95943 if wanted. If the lexicon needs a decorative sense, it needs a different fingerprint and a new sentence set, not this document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 束头发或装饰头发的带子 names the same referent as sense 95943 (绑头发或戴在头上的带子). There is no lexical split, and 95944 sentence 8 (她用发带把长头发束了起来) duplicates 95943 sentence 5 (她把头发用发带绑起来了). Keeping both creates two senses a learner cannot tell apart.; variants.A.synonym_antonym_match: This block is not in the plan for this sense (plan A lists only level_1, level_3, level_6 and level_7). It is extra.

definition: 从过去到现在一直。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate only; the individual blocks were not otherwise judged. If the duplicate is ever kept instead of 96125, B level_6 wrong sentence 3 (小王一向戒烟了。) is borderline and should be replaced with a clearly time-conflicting sentence. Its A and B level_3 options and A level_6 are otherwise sound.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same sense as 96125: 从过去到现在一直如此, with the same pos, semantic_class, register and fingerprint. This is a duplicate sense, not a second one.

definition: 楼房的第一层；也指一个层面。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is unusable as one sense. Several blocks also mix senses: B level_6 wrong sentences test floor-sense errors against a figurative correct sentence, and A level_6 uses floor-sense distractors. The floor-sense sentences (商场的一层卖化妆品, 我在一层停车, 地铁站在一层, 医院的一层是挂号的地方, 一层的灯坏了) duplicate 96127. Figurative sentences (他的话里还有一层意思, 这件事还有一层原因, 这个故事还有一层深意, 他想到了更深的一层, 你想想这里面的一层关系) need a separate sense and plan. No sentence is marked mined.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition fuses two senses: 楼房的第一层 and 引申为一个层面 (a figurative layer). Its sentences mix both: floor sentences (0, 2, 4, 6, 8) and figurative sentences (1, 3, 5, 7, 9). This breaks the rule that every sentence uses one sense.

definition: 参见别处的相关内容。
reviewer_notes: Judged as a separate sense only, so reject. Sentences and blocks are otherwise sound, with valid L3 distractors (修理/跳/唱) and correct L6 and L7 indices. L7 A 「相关内容另见在附表」 is marginal; 「在」 is not clearly ungrammatical there. The same level_1 decline issue as 96163 applies if the sense is ever reinstated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96163 的义项完全重复：「参见别处的相关内容」与「告诉你去别的地方看相关的内容」指同一用法，两个义项会生成内容重复的练习。

definition: 以出卖肉体为生的女子。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，不宜保留。若决定保留，需同时修正 core.ipa 的第三声标注（同 96175）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “以出卖肉体为生的女子”与 sense 96175 “靠出卖身体来赚钱的女人”为同一义项，sense_fingerprint 也几乎相同。这是重复的 sense，练习会重复出题。

definition: 房间里面。
reviewer_notes: 核心重复，不宜保留。若决定保留，另有以下问题需处理：A L3 “演唱会很安静，只有他一个人”可理解为空场演出，干扰项不成立；B L3 “工地没有一点声音”在门关着的语境下也可成立；A L6 “室内结了一层厚冰”可指冷库，属可接受句。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “房间里面”与 sense 96177 “房子里面，与室外相对”为同一义项，sense_fingerprint 也基本相同，属重复 sense。

definition: 具有一定形状和体积的实物。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for a bad core. Its block-level content is otherwise coherent, but the two senses cannot be taught separately, and the cross-sense conflict above shows it. Keep 96237. The B level_7 那条物体 is borderline in the same way as 96237.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicates sense 96237. Both glosses describe a real object one can see and touch (or one with shape and volume), and all ten sentences fit both. The fingerprint's added domain tag (科学、观察) is not a sense difference.; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: 形体 is close to the target gloss (形状和体积). Its stated reason (书面语域) conflicts with the sense's register 中性, so the explanation is wrong.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “水是一种物体” is wrong only under this gloss. Under 96237 (能看到、能摸到的东西) water is plainly a 物体, so the wrong sentence contradicts the sibling sense.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[2]: “这家商店卖很多日用物体” is not clearly wrong by sense. The real defect is collocation/register (物品 is the usual word), and the explanation does not say that clearly.

definition: 整体中的某一部分的位置。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a sense-splitting duplicate, not for a content defect; the block-level content I checked was clean. If the inventory deliberately keeps both senses, the sentences would have to be rewritten to separate them, which requires a new core rather than patches.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense of 96275. Both mean a region or part of a whole, and 96276's sentences (e.g. 这台机器的每个部位都有名字, 医生问我疼痛的部位在哪里) are equally correct under 96275's gloss.

definition: 用来装钱和卡片的小包。
reviewer_notes: Rejected as a duplicate sense, not for block-level content. If the sense is kept anyway, B level_7 has the same 把-word-order problem as 96277 (他把拿走了钱包), so it would need the same measure-word replacement.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Duplicate sense of 96277 (钱包 as a small pouch for money). 卡片 is typical contents, not a separate sense, and every sentence here is equally correct under 96277's gloss.

definition: 有些国家里，由很多人坐在一起商量国家大事的地方。
reviewer_notes: Rejected on the core. Cross-sense conflict: under this gloss, 国会 (the sibling 96324 A level_3 distractor) is defensibly correct, so the two senses cannot both ship. The block-level content is clean: the level_3 distractors 医院, 厨房, 菜市场, 学期, 咖啡 and 歌曲 are wrong, the level_6 wrong sentences are wrong for stated reasons, and the level_7 errors (只 and 过过) are clean. Sentences fit the gloss, so this is a core problem only.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The gloss (有些国家里，由很多人坐在一起商量国家大事的地方) describes any legislature, including 众议院 and 国会. It is not 参议院's own meaning. It duplicates sense 96324, which gives the correct upper-house meaning.

definition: 一种话里所有的词，或者你会的词。
reviewer_notes: 因义项重复而拒绝，不对变体内容作逐条判定。抽查时各区块内部自洽（每个 level_3 仅一个正确项，level_6 的错误句均有明确理由），因此唯一缺陷在义项本身。计划中 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但计划与文档中均无对应区块，未核实。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96452 实为同一义项。本条把「一种话里所有的词」与「你会的词」合并为一个义项，而 96452 已以「一种语言或个人所使用的全部词的总和」覆盖这两种读法。两条的例句也高度重叠（如「英语词汇」「这些词汇」「我想多学一些新词汇」与 96452 的同类句），学习者会在两套练习里学到同一个义项。; core.sense_fingerprint: 「自己会的词或一种话里的词」与 96452 的指纹「一种语言或个人全部词的总和」重复，无法区分义项。

definition: 做一件从来没有人做过的新事。
reviewer_notes: 因义项重复而拒绝，不是因为句子有缺陷。若团队决定保留本条，区块内容基本可用：A/B 的 level_3 各仅一个正确项；level_6 的错误句理由成立（如「开创了一颗新星」应为〈发现〉）；level_7 两处错误（「正在……了」「……了过」）各只有一个且判定正确。计划区块与文档一致。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与 96468 义项重复。「做一件从来没有人做过的新事」与 96468 的「首次创立；开辟」都是「首次开创」，两者的指纹差别只在宾语类型，学习者无法据此区分。例句也重叠，如本条「这部电影开创了……新时代」与 96468「国家改革开放，开创了新的时代」。; core.sense_fingerprint: 「首创前人没做过的方法、做法或先例」与 96468 的「首次创立公司、事业、时代等并开辟新局面」指向同一核心意义，区分度不足。

definition: 开始做；也指熟练掌握，容易操作。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as one sense, so no patches. Declined blocks were not reviewed. Relevant to 96485: the 着手 meaning overlaps that sense.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.sense_fingerprint: The sense covers two meanings: 开始做/着手 (sentences 5, 6, 8) and 熟练掌握/容易操作 (the other seven). This breaks one-sense pinning. The 着手 meaning also overlaps sense 96485 (刚学会用、开始会用).; variants.B.level_3 / variants.B.level_7: B level_3 (sentence 6) and B level_7 (index 6) rely on the 着手 meaning, so they would not survive a split.; variants.A.level_7 / variants.B.level_7: The errors (上手快很, 上手很得快) are complement-position errors, not errors in 上手's usage. The checklist requires the error to involve the target.

definition: 语气词，用于句末，表示反问或推测；也表示不行。
reviewer_notes: Core is unusable as one sense, so no patches. Declined blocks were not reviewed. The 不行 sense's A level_7 error (很不成 vs 可不成) and B level_3 options are sound for that sense and could be reused after the rebuild.
reviewer_issues: core.definition / core.pos / core.sense_fingerprint: The sense merges two meanings: 反问/推测 (sentences 0, 4, 5, 7, 8) and 不行 (sentences 1, 2, 3, 6, 9). The 反问 meaning duplicates sense 96487. The 不行 use is a predicate, so pos 助词 is wrong for it.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences / variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences: Wrong sentences 快走，不成要迟到了 and 早点说，不成大家等 use 不成 as 否则, which is contestable (same problem as 96487).

definition: 用力把东西取下来，或者赢了比赛。
reviewer_notes: reject 因核心义项切分错误。另：两个变体的 synonym_antonym_match 均以 no_relation 放弃，但取下义有明显反义“挂上 / 装上”，获胜义有“输 / 输掉”（B 的 level_3 已用输掉作干扰项）。计划允许放弃，重建时可补做。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，而 blocks 中没有对应块，需确认是否有意省略。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义把两个义项合并：“用力把东西取下来”（取下）与“赢了比赛”（获胜）。sentences 0-4 为取下义，5-9 为获胜义；variants.A 教取下，variants.B 教获胜，实际是一份文档装两个义项。; core.sense_fingerprint: 指纹同时含“从高处取下”与“赢得比赛奖项”，无法锁定单一义项。; core.sentences[5]-core.sentences[9]: 与 sense 96544 重叠：获胜义句子在两份文档中重复，取下义又与 96544 的 sentences[8]-[9] 重复，两个 sense 的边界互相穿插。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: “大风把那棵老树拿下了。”被标为错误，但本文档 definition 写的是“用力把东西取下来”。在该义下此句并非明显错误，错因（推倒）不干净，判题者可能给 2-3 分。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “这首歌拿下了观众的掌声”：口语中“拿下观众”“拿下人心”较常见，标注的“抽象对象不能搭配”说得过绝，母语者可能接受。

definition: 取下；攻占；在比赛中获胜。
reviewer_notes: reject 因核心义项切分错误。level_3 两个变体的干扰项（取下、缩小、摘下；放下、吞下、拍下）本身检查通过。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9 而 blocks 无对应块，同上需确认。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 定义合并三个义项：取下、攻占、在比赛中获胜，违反单义项锁定。其中取下义与 sense 96543 重复。; core.sentences[8]-core.sentences[9]: “他拿下帽子”“老师拿下眼镜”用的是取下义，而 sense_fingerprint 把取下放在次要位置。variants.B.level_6 的正确句（sentences[9]）因此落在指纹之外。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “他们拿下来了那座城。”被标为错误，错因“攻占城池不用拿下来”不成立。口语中“拿下来”可表示搞定、拿到（如拿下来一个项目），此句并非明显错误，“拿下了”也非唯一可接受的改法。

definition: 无趣；不值得；也指没有含义。
reviewer_notes: Reject, because the core sense is a blend of three meanings and two sentences belong to 96577's sense. A valid split would keep 没有含义 (sentences 1, 2, 3, 6, 8, with 1 ambiguous between 无趣 and 无意义 and worth tightening). Sentences 0, 5, and 7 (不值得) need a decision: either fold them into 96577 or treat them as a separate sense with its own definition. Level_7 A and B are otherwise fine, and A synonym 有意思 is correct for the 无意义 reading, but the whole sense must be regenerated.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 无趣；不值得；也指没有含义 bundles three senses into one. 无趣 is already the 96577 sense (不好玩). The sense is not locked to one meaning, so the sentences cannot be checked against a single definition.; core.sense_fingerprint: The fingerprint 无趣、不值得，或没有含义 is a disjunction of three senses, so it cannot discriminate this sense from 96577.; core.sentences[4]: 一直做同样的事，我觉得没有意思。 uses the 无趣 sense, which duplicates 96577.; core.sentences[9]: 整天看手机，真没有意思，出去走走吧。 uses the 无趣 sense, which duplicates 96577. It is also the B level_6 correct sentence and the B synonym sentence.; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: 严重 is defensibly correct in 为这点小事吵架，太严重了 (想得太严重 is an idiomatic overreaction). Its explanation 与这点小事矛盾 is weak, so the blank has two defensible answers.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 他的胃口… duplicates a 96577 wrong sentence. Specifically, 我今天身体没有意思，不想出门。 (B wrong[0]) matches 96577 A level_6 wrong[2], and wrong[1] and wrong[2] match 96577 B level_6 wrong[1] and [2]. Reused distractors across senses contaminate the bank.

definition: 使马缓步而行；多用于固定说法。
reviewer_notes: The core is unusable: definition, fingerprint and sentences describe different meanings. Level_3 and level_6 options were not reviewed in depth because the core must be redone first. Level_1 and synonym_antonym_match were declined and are not reported.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: The definition 使马缓步而行 describes literal horse-walking, but all ten sentences use the idioms 走马观花 (glance over) or 走马上任 (take office). None uses the stated sense.; core.sentences: The sentences mix two different idiomatic meanings (草草看 and 就职) and neither is the literal sense. The target 走马 has no independent meaning inside these idioms, which fails the checklist rule against compounds that embed the word.

definition: 竞赛中授予第一名的金质奖牌。
reviewer_notes: 拒绝的理由是冗余而非内容错误，请人工复核后再决定。B level_6 的三个错误句（“他一直想当金牌。”“他获得了博士金牌。”“他这次拿到了一笔金牌。”）与 96695 B level_6 完全相同。若保留本条，B level_7 的“这只金牌”也有与 96695 相同的“只”问题。A level_3 的“硬币”干扰项在该句中也不太成立。plan 的 active_levels 含 2、4、9，但 blocks 中没有对应块。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 义项“竞赛中授予第一名的金质奖牌”与 96695 的“比赛得第一名时得到的金色奖牌”是同一个义项，指向同一种实物。两条都会教授同一个含义，学习者会重复练习同一个义项。

definition: 先后担任过多种职务。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 96753. Its sentences are reusable under 96753 once the 96753 patches are applied. If the curator wants both senses, the two definitions must differ on a real meaning, and the issues above must be fixed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与96753重复。“先后担任过多种职务”与96753的“一个接一个地做过很多工作或职位”在学习者层面意义相同，仅履历／官职的语域不同，无法让学习者分辨两个义项。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “撤销”的解释推理颠倒。撤销的施事是主语，“他撤销县长”说的是他撤职别人，而不是他被撤职。; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0..1]: “他历任社区的委员多年。”与“她历任小学校长。”都是单一职位的历任，履历中常见，母语者多半接受，不算明确错句。; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: “他历任销售经理。”同样是单一职位，不算明确错句。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “张将军指挥排长、连长和营长”语法通顺，可表示军中的指挥关系，不能确定排除，不宜作为干扰项。

definition: 每一个地方；各处。
reviewer_notes: Reject as a duplicate of 96765. Its sentences are reusable under 96765 after that sense's patches. If the curator wants this sense, the definition must be made distinct, and the issues above must be fixed.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: 与96765重复。“遍及”与“逐一”的差别在于范围，学习者无法据此分辨两个义项，两者的释义都是“每一个地方”。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “这座古镇每处很安静”省去“都”，属于边缘用法，不能确定为错句。; core.pos: 词性标为名词不妥，每处是代词性结构。

definition: 物体的外表样式。
reviewer_notes: reject 因与 96855 重复。其余句子与选项未发现额外问题（A 的量词错误句、B 的“一只”错误句均单一）。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “物体的外表样式”与 sense 96855 的“从外面看东西是什么样子”是同一义项，sense_fingerprint 也重叠。作为独立 sense 没有区分度，属重复。; core.sentences[5]: 句子对象含 schema 之外的 furigana 字段，与其他句子结构不一致。; variants.B.level_6.correct_sentence_index (sentences[9]): 正确句“这台冰箱外观不大，但是很好用。”：外观是外表样式，没有大小可言，应说外形或体积，作为“正确”范例不够自然。variants.B.level_7 的改正句与之相同，同样受影响。

definition: 大人说的女人。
reviewer_notes: 判为reject的理由是与96872重复。96872保留了时代标签，更接近词典的释义。若团队仍要保留96871，须先修复上述问题，首先是元语言句。另外，morphological_forms中的“个”（量词）不是女人家的形态变化，请确认。
reviewer_issues: core.definition: “大人说的女人”描述的是用法而非所指。它与96872的“指妇女（口语）”所指相同、语域相同，“大人说话时”与“旧时”的差异只是语境或时代色彩，不构成独立义项。两义项实质重复。; core.sentences[6].text: “我常听大人说“女人家”这个词”是元语言句，提及而非使用该词，违反整词整义使用的要求；并且它是B的level_3空位，使“女士们”等替换也语法通顺。; variants.A.level_3.options[2]: “女王陛下要学会照顾自己”语法通顺，只靠语域排除，属于可辩护的替代。; variants.A.level_3.options[3]: “小狗要学会照顾自己”语法通顺，语义也有一定合理性，不是明确错误。; variants.B.level_3.options[1]: “女士们”在元语言句中语法通顺，区别仅在礼貌程度，且其解释依赖元语言句。; variants.A.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “女人家们”的“们”在口语中可接受，错误句的理由有争议。; variants.B.level_7.incorrect_sentence: “那些女人家们”的“们”同样有争议，不能可靠地算作唯一错误。

definition: 留作后用的余地、办法；后来的一步。
reviewer_notes: Rejected because the core is not a distinct sense, so patching would mean re-deciding the sense inventory. No patches are proposed. If a separate sense is kept, its level_6 wrong sentences 这个决定的后手很严重 (A[1]), 这种病的后手很难治 (A[2]), and 全靠父母做后手 (B[0]) rest on the colloquial aftermath or backup reading, so they would need replacing. The 老板 and 笑话 level_3 distractors are also weak.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: This sense duplicates 96917. Both define 后手 as a backup measure kept for later use, and the sentences use the same meaning. The 事先/事后 timing split is not a real sense difference. The 后来的一步 gloss has no supporting sentence.; core.sentences[7]: 他说话从来不留后手 means holds nothing back (无保留). That meaning is in neither definition, so the sentence does not match this sense.

definition: 一只手，也有一种本事的意思。
reviewer_notes: Reject because the core cannot be repaired by patching. The single definition merges the hand sense and the skill sense, so every level_6 and level_7 wrong sentence that uses the hand sense is actually correct. 97108 has the same two-meaning definition, so the pair is a duplicate and needs one re-split. Separately, variants A level_3 uses 「他一手扶着门，一手拿着钥匙」, which contains 一手 twice. The second copy cues the answer, so the cloze needs a sentence with a single instance.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: One definition merges two senses: 「一只手」 (one hand) and 「本事」 (skill). Sentences 0, 5 and 8 use the hand sense; the rest use the skill sense. The sense is not one sense, so the discrimination blocks cannot be made clean.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「他一手抓着扶手，一手提着箱子。」 uses 一手 as a concrete one-hand action. Under this definition that use is correct, so the sentence is not a wrong one.; variants.A.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「他一手揣着口袋，一手拿着手机。」 is the same concrete one-hand use and is acceptable under this definition.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[0]: 「他一手托着茶杯，一手翻书。」 is a concrete one-hand use and is acceptable under this definition.; variants.B.level_6.wrong_sentences[1]: 「他一手拿着手机，一手抓着栏杆。」 is a concrete one-hand use and is acceptable under this definition.; variants.B.level_3.options[3]: 「一身」 can measure skills (一身本领 / 一身武艺), so 「我也想学一身，以后自己做饭」 is defensibly correct. The stated reason (clothing) is also wrong.; variants.B.level_1.options[3]: 「一寿」 is not an established word. Phonetic distractors must be real words.; variants.B.level_1.options[4]: 「一少」 is not an established word.

definition: 一只手；也指一种技能或手艺。
reviewer_notes: Reject. This sense duplicates 97107 with the same merged definition. Its level_6 wrong sentences A[0], A[1] and B[0] are concrete one-hand uses that are correct under the definition as written. The semantic_class label does not match the sentence mix. Variants A level_3 uses 「他一手拿着伞，一手拿着书」, which repeats 一手 and so cues the answer. Resolve the 97107/97108 pair with one re-split before rebuilding either document.
reviewer_issues: core.definition: Same merged definition as 97107 (one hand plus skill).
